investmentObjective.heading: 投資目標
investmentObjective.zh: 透過投資於核准匯集投資基金及/或核准指數計劃，致力尋求長期資本增值。該等核准匯集投資基金及/或核准指數計劃主要投資於在大中華地區（即中國、香港、澳門及台灣）上市、以當地為基地或主要在當地經營之公司的股本證券。大中華股票基金將其少於30%的資產淨值投資於中國A股。投資政策的實施被視為高固有風險。
investmentObjective.en: To seek long-term capital appreciation through investing in APIFs and/or Approved ITCISs which invest primarily in equity securities of companies listed, based or operating principally in the Greater China region i.e. the PRC, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan. The Greater China Equity Fund will invest less than 30% of its NAV in China A-shares. Implementation of the investment policy is considered to be of high inherent risk.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理報告
managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得5.77%回報。主要拖累來自於香港股票策略。恒生指數在五月下跌了2.3%。但地產分類指數表現相對較好。根據差餉物業估價署的資料，香港四月份的房價按年上漲了10.5%，並升至兩年半以來的高位。恒生中國企業指數下跌了2.9%。儘管習特峰會未能達成聯合聲明，但兩國政府達成「建設性戰略穩定關係」的共識。五月份滬深300指數上升了1.8%。與人工智能相關的投資主題仍受投資者關注。科技分類指數上漲超過16%，電信服務分類指數則跳升了24%。中國經濟數據依然呈現出喜憂參半的情況。主要城市的房地產市場有回穩跡象，出口增長持續加快，官方製造業採購經理指數從四月的50.1於五月上升至50.5。然而，四月份零售銷售和工業生產的年度增速有所放緩。台灣證券交易所加權指數在五月份上漲近15%。台灣的工業生產和出口行業繼續受惠於與人工智能相關零件需求的激增，均於四月份錄得雙位數的年度增長。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 5.77% return in May. The main detractors were the Hong Kong equities. The Hang Seng Index went down by 2.3% in May. The property sub-index continued to outperform. According to Rating and Valuation Department, home prices in Hong Kong jumped by 10.5% year-on-year in April and reached the highest level in two-and-a-half years. The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index lost 2.9%. Although the Xi-Trump summit did not conclude a joint declaration, both governments agree on “constructive strategic stability” between the two countries. The CSI 300 Index went up by 1.8% in May. Investor focus remained on Artificial Intelligence-related theme. The information technology sub-index surged more than 16% and the telecommunication services sub-index soared 24%. China’s economic data remained mixed. Property markets in China’s major cities showed sign of stabilization and export growth kept accelerating. The official Purchasing Managers Index increased to 50.5 in May from April’s 50.1. However, the yearly growth of retail sales and industrial production decelerated in April. The Taiwan Stock Exchange Weighted Index gained by almost 15% in May. Taiwan’s industrial production and export sector continued to benefit from surging Artificial Intelligence related component demand and registered double-digit yearly growth in April.

investmentObjective.heading: 投資目標
investmentObjective.zh: 首要目標是透過投資於兩個或以上核准匯集投資基金及/或核准指數計劃盡量減低其以港元計算的短期資本風險。第二目標是透過有限投資於全球股票而提供長遠超越港元存款利率的回報。穩定資本組合不保證付還本金。
investmentObjective.en: The primary objective, through investing in two or more APIFs and/or Approved ITCISs, is to minimise its short-term capital risk in HK dollar terms. The secondary objective is to provide returns over the long term that exceeds HK dollar deposit rates through limited exposure to global equities. The Capital Stable Portfolio does not guarantee the repayment of capital.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理報告
managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得1.39%回報。主要貢獻來自於亞太區（除日本外）股票。富時強積金世界政府債券指數在五月微升0.4%。債券市場在五月中旬曾大幅波動，十年期德國國債息率觸及自2011年以來的最高水平，而日本十年期國債息率飆升至近三十年來的高位。但隨著美伊雙方在月底前宣布臨時停火，緩解了市場對通脹的擔憂，並穩定了投資者的信心。五月份，美國十年期國債息率於一年內首次上升至4.6%。富時強積金全球股票指數在五月上漲了5.3%。美國與伊朗之間恢復談判，以及延長臨時停火協議都提升了市場的樂觀情緒。因投資者持續將焦點投放在可以受惠於人工智能發展的產業，科技股繼續領跑大市。隨著中東地緣政治緊張局勢有所緩解，全球經濟增長勢頭回升。四月份摩根大通全球綜合採購經理指數從上月的51.0升至51.8。富時強積金亞太（日本除外）指數於5月份以港元計升幅達9.5%。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 1.39% return in May. The main contributors were Asia Pacific ex Japan equities. The FTSE MPF World Government Bond Index was mildly up by 0.4% in May. Bond market volatility increased in the middle of May with the 10-year German Bund yield hitting the highest since 2011 and the 10-year yield of Japanese government bond nearing a three-decade high. Investor confidence returned later in the month as temporary ceasefire in the Middle East helped ease concerns about inflation. In May, the 10-year United States Treasury yield rose to 4.6% for the first time in a year. The FTSE MPF All World Index was up by 5.3% in May. Renewed talks between the United States and Iran as well as a tentative ceasefire extension boosted market optimism. Technology sector led the rallies as investors continued focusing on industries that could benefit from the development of Artificial Intelligence. The pace of worldwide economic momentum recovered in the midst of de-escalation of geopolitical tension in the Middle East. In April, the J.P.Morgan Global Composite Purchasing Managers’ Index rose to 51.8 from previous month’s 51.0. The FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex Japan Index rallied by 9.5% in May in HKD term.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理報告
managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得0.14%回報。本月，由於正值派息季節，本地資金狀況有所收緊，導致香港短期利率大致上揚。進入6月，除了基於本地的資金情況外，地緣政治局勢持續緊張，當前宏觀經濟狀況變化和美國政策的不確定性可能會繼續改變市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期，亦會影響香港短期利率的走勢。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 0.14% return in May. Hong Kong Dollar (HKD) short term rates moved higher broadly during the month as the funding condition in the HKD market tightened amid the dividend payment season. Going into June, in addition to the domestic funding condition, the elevated rate fluctuations driven by ongoing geopolitical tensions, evolving global macroeconomic conditions and uncertainties surrounding US policies, which may continue to shape market expectations on the US monetary decisions and impact HKD short term rates.

In May, the Korea Composite Stock Price Index jumped by a whopping 28.4%, outperforming other major equity indices. The economy’s strategic position in Artificial Intelligence supply chains and semiconductor production continues to draw investors’ attention. Artificial Intelligence driven rallies sent both the Nikkei 225 and the Tokyo Stock Price Index to their record closing highs in May. The Tokyo Stock Price Index rose 6.2 % and the Nikkei 225 index registered a whopping 11.9% gain because Technology sector has higher weighting in the latter index. In the first quarter, Japan’s real Gross Domestic Product grew at an annualised rate of 2.1% after adjusting for seasonality. The pace was faster than the previous quarter and market expectations.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理報告
managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得2.84%回報。就國家而言，美國是帶動投資組合表現的主要因素，相反英國則拖累組合表現。就行業而言，資訊科技帶動相對回報，而工業則拖累表現。市場升勢主要受惠於油價回落、中東達成協議的預期，以及與AI相關的科技企業業績表現。不過，大宗商品短缺在短期內料將持續，通脹壓力亦可能仍然偏高。因此，投資團隊的焦點仍然放在那些能夠錄得強勁盈利，並可將較高成本轉嫁予消費者的企業，以維持利潤率。投資團隊正以全球視野尋找這類公司，尤其留意日本（通脹重估故事）、歐洲及新興市場。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 2.84% return in May. At the country level, The United States was the key contributor, while the United Kingdom detracted. At the sector level, Information Technology added to the relative return, while Industrials detracted. The market rally has been driven by lower oil prices, Middle East deal expectations and AI-related tech earnings. However, commodity shortages are likely to persist and inflationary pressures will remain elevated in the near term. Hence, investment team’s focus remains on businesses that can deliver strong earnings and pass on these higher costs to consumers in order to preserve margins. Investment team are exploring such companies with a global view, particularly in Japan (reflation story), Europe and the emerging markets.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理報告
managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得5.71%回報。主要貢獻來自資訊科技產業。美股三大指數均在五月創下收盤新高。這一輪升幅集中在科技板塊，主要受到對人工智能的樂觀情緒支持。其中納斯達克綜合指數上漲了8.4%，表現優於標準普爾500指數（升5.1%）和道瓊斯工業平均指數（升2.8%）。第一季度經季節調整後的國內生產總值年化增長率，由先前的2.0%被下調至1.6%。中東軍事衝突及霍爾木茲海峽封鎖所引發的不確定性為經濟前景蒙上陰影。四月的經濟統計顯示，消費者和生產物價通脹率都持續加速。美國股票市場前景維持審慎樂觀，受到經濟增長具韌性及企業盈利穩健的支持，儘管宏觀不確定性仍然存在。2026年第一季為一個表現異常強勁的業績季度，在人工智慧（AI）驅動的科技龍頭帶動下，各行業的增長動能逐步擴散，整體業績亦大幅優於市場預期。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 5.71% return in May. The main contributor was the Information Technology sector. The three major equity indices in the United States hit record closing highs in May. The rally was underpinned by optimism on Artificial Intelligence and concentrated on Technology sector with the Nasdaq Composite Index rising 8.4%, outperforming the Standard and Poor’s 500 Index (up 5.1%) and the Dow Jones Industrial Average (up 2.8%). In the first quarter, the seasonally adjusted annualised growth rate of Gross Domestic Product was revised lower to 1.6% from the earlier estimate of 2.0%. The uncertainties caused by Middle East military conflicts and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz clouded economic outlook. Economic statistics in April showed that both consumer and producer inflation kept accelerating. The US equity market outlook remains cautiously constructive, supported by resilient economic growth and solid corporate earnings, despite lingering macro uncertainties. Q1 2026 was an exceptionally strong earnings season, led by AI-driven tech giants, with improving breadth across sectors and results significantly beating expectations.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理報告
managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得2.06%回報。基金績效方面，材料和資本貨物行業的選股作出了貢獻。而軟件和服務的選股，以及商業和專業服務行業的較高持倉則構成拖累。泛歐斯托克600指數在5月錄得上升。然而，由於能源價格上漲推高了生產成本，影響歐元區的經濟活動。高企的通脹預期將逐步削弱消費者的購買力，從而影響經濟增長。五月份綜合採購經理指數初值下跌至47.5，為2023年以來的最低讀數。低於50的採購經理指數表示經濟活動正在收縮。中東能源衝擊為通脹帶來了更明顯的上行風險。地緣政治不確定性加劇，對歐元區經濟活動構成壓力。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 2.06% return in May. For the fund performance, positive contributors included stock selection in Materials and Capital Goods. Detractors included stock selection in Software & Services and an overweight position in Commercial & Professional Services. The Stoxx Europe 600 Index registered positive return in May. However, the Eurozone economy lost steam as rising energy prices pushed up production costs. Higher inflation is expected to gradually undermine consumers’ purchasing power and thus economic growth. The preliminary Composite Purchasing Managers’ Index for the month of May fell to 47.5, the lowest reading since 2023. Sub-50 purchasing manager’s index indicates contraction in economic activity. The energy shock from the Middle East introduces a clearer upside risk to inflation. Rising geopolitical uncertainty is weighing on euro area economic activities.

investmentObjective.zh: 首要目標是盡量減低以港元計算的資本風險。第二目標則是達致穩定、持續性及可預計的回報。
investmentObjective.en: The primary objective is to minimise capital risk in HK dollar terms. The secondary objective is to achieve a stable, consistent and predictable rate of return.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理報告
managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得0.13%回報。本月，香港政府港元債券收益率曲線跟隨美國國債收益率曲線而上行。就港元信貸而言，信用利差大致上收窄。踏入6月，在地緣政治局勢維持緊張、全球宏觀經濟發展以及美國政策不確定性的影響下，市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期不斷改變，港元債券收益率料將持續波動。同時，本港經濟情況及投資於股票或避險資產的港元資金流向亦會影響港元債券收益率。因此，中長期優質港元債券仍然是投資重點，以獲得具吸引力的回報，同時亦能減少利率波動對價格的負面影響。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 0.13% return in May. Hong Kong government HKD bond yield curve shifted upwards in May, tracking the US Treasury yield curve. In terms of HKD credits, spreads generally tightened during the month. Going into June, HKD bond yields are expected to remain volatile amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, global macroeconomic development and US policies uncertainties, which influence market expectations on the US monetary decisions. Meanwhile, Hong Kong domestic economic conditions and HKD fund flows for equity investments or pursuit of haven assets also influence HKD bond yields. As such, medium to long term high-quality HKD bonds continue to be the investment focus for attractive return while minimising the negative price impact from interest rates fluctuations.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理報告
managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得0.14%回報。富時強積金世界政府債券指數（35%港元對沖）5月份錄得上升。美國國債利率曲線上升抵銷了來自利息收入的回報。美國與伊朗之間達成協議的初步嘗試取得了進展，預示著中東地緣政治局勢可能緩和。宏觀經濟方面，美國第一季經濟增長從最初預估2%下調至1.6%（年率）。4月非農就業人數超出預期達11.5萬人，失業率維持在4.3%的穩定水平。通脹數據顯示，整體消費者物價指數年增3.8%，核心消費者物價指數年增2.8%。歐元區5月綜合採購經理人指數初值降至47.5，創2023年以來新低。第一季經濟增長按季放緩至0.1%，同時2026年通脹預期升至2.7%。貨幣政策方面，聯儲局示意維持中性取態，不認為升息是基本預期。相較之下，歐洲央行和英國央行則表示，鑑於持續存在的通脹擔憂，進一步收緊貨幣政策的可能性依然存在。10年期美國國債利率從4月的4.37%上升至4.44%。10年期日本國債利率從4月的2.52%上升至2.66%。10年期德國國債利率從4月的3.04%下降至2.93%。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 0.14% return in May. The FTSE MPF World Government Bond Index (35% Hong Kong Dollar hedged) rose in May. The upward shift in the United States (“US”) yield curve offset the return coming from interest income. A credible attempt for an agreement between the US and Iran emerged, signalling a potential geopolitical de-escalation in the Middle East. On the macro front, the first quarter GDP in the US was revised downward to a 1.6% annualised rate from initial estimate of 2%. The nonfarm payrolls in April exceeded expectations at 115,000 with unemployment rate remaining stable at 4.3%. Inflation data showed the headline CPI rose 3.8% year-on-year (YoY), while core CPI increased by 2.8% YoY. In the Eurozone, the flash Composite PMI fell to 47.5 in May, marking the lowest level since 2023. The first quarter GDP slowed to 0.1% quarter-over-quarter alongside a rise in inflation expectation to 2.7% for 2026. From the monetary policy perspective, the Federal Reserve signalled a neutral policy stance and does not view a hike as the base case. In contrast, the European Central Bank and Bank of England indicated further tightening remains a possibility amid persistent inflation concerns. The 10-year US Treasury yield ended May at 4.44%, up from 4.37% a month earlier. The 10-year Japanese government bond yield rose to 2.66% in May, up from 2.52% a month earlier. The 10-year German Bund yield fell to 2.93% from 3.04% at the end of April.

managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得0.31%回報。基金表現主要由於利息收入推動。本月，由於油價波動及通脹數據高出預期，導致美國國債收益率曲線向上移動，而短端升幅較長端為高。在亞洲美元信貸方面，信用利差有所收窄。進入6月，由於地緣政治局勢維持緊張，當前宏觀經濟狀況和美國總統特朗普政策的不確定性，可能會改變市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期，美國國債收益率因此會持續波動。因此，中長期優質亞洲美元債券仍然是投資重點，以獲得具吸引力的回報，同時亦減少利率波動對價格的負面影響。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 0.31% return in May. Performance was driven mainly by interest income. The US Treasury yield curve shifted upwards with short-end rising more than long-end, in light of oil price volatility and higher-than-expected inflation data. Asian Dollar credits spreads narrowed during the month. Going into June, US Treasury bond yields may continue to stay volatile amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, current macroeconomic conditions and uncertainties regarding US President Trump’s policies, which influence market expectations on the US monetary decisions. As such, medium to long term high-quality USD bonds continue to be the investment focus for attractive return while minimising the negative price impact from interest rates fluctuations.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理報告
managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得5.82%回報。主要貢獻來自於亞太區（除日本外）股票。富時強積金亞太（日本除外）指數於5月份以港元計升幅達9.5%。在五月，韓國綜合股價指數的漲幅高達28.4%，表現超越其他主要股市指數。該國在人工智能供應鏈和半導體生產方面的戰略地位，持續受到投資者注視。台灣證券交易所加權指數在五月份上漲近15%。台灣的工業生產和出口行業繼續受惠於與人工智能相關零件需求的激增，均於四月份錄得雙位數的年度增長。歐洲斯托克指數在五月上升了3%。然而，由於能源價格上漲推高了生產成本，影響歐元區的經濟活動。高企的通脹預期將逐步削弱消費者的購買力，從而影響經濟增長。五月份綜合採購經理指數初值下跌至47.5，為2023年以來的最低讀數。低於50的採購經理指數表示經濟活動正在收縮。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 5.82% return in May. The main contributors were Asia Pacific ex Japan equities. The FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex Japan Index rallied by 9.5% in May in HKD term. In May, the Korea Composite Stock Price Index jumped by a whopping 28.4%, outperforming other major equity indices. The economy’s strategic position in Artificial Intelligence supply chains and semiconductor production continues to draw investors’ attention. The Taiwan Stock Exchange Weighted Index gained by almost 15% in May. Taiwan’s industrial production and export sector continued to benefit from surging Artificial Intelligence related component demand and registered double-digit yearly growth in April. The Euro Stoxx Index went up by 3% in May. However, the Eurozone economy lost steam as rising energy prices pushed up production costs. Higher inflation is expected to gradually undermine consumers’ purchasing power and thus economic growth. The preliminary composite Purchasing Managers’ Index for the month of May fell to 47.5, the lowest reading since 2023. Sub-50 Purchasing Manager’s Index indicates contraction in economic activity.

managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 5.12% return in May. The main contributor was the Information Technology sector. The three major equity indices in the United States hit record closing highs in May. The rally was underpinned by optimism on Artificial Intelligence and concentrated on Technology sector with the Nasdaq Composite Index rising 8.4%, outperforming the Standard and Poor’s 500 Index (up 5.1%) and the Dow Jones Industrial Average (up 2.8%). In the first quarter, the seasonally adjusted annualised growth rate of Gross Domestic Product was revised lower to 1.6% from the earlier estimate of 2.0%. The uncertainties caused by Middle East military conflicts and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz clouded economic outlook. Economic statistics in April showed that both consumer and producer inflation kept accelerating.

managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded 3.50% return in May. The main contributors were global equities. The FTSE MPF All World Index was up by 5.3% in May. Renewed talks between the United States and Iran as well as a tentative ceasefire extension boosted market optimism. Technology sector led the rallies as investors continued focusing on industries that could benefit from the development of Artificial Intelligence. The pace of worldwide economic momentum recovered in the midst of de-escalation of geopolitical tension in the Middle East. In April, the J.P.Morgan Global Composite Purchasing Managers’ Index rose to 51.8 from previous month’s 51.0. The FTSE MPF World Government Bond Index (100% HKD Hedged) was mildly up by 0.4% in May. Bond market volatility increased in the middle of May with the 10-year German Bund yield hitting the highest since 2011 and the 10-year yield of Japanese government bond nearing a three-decade high. Investor confidence returned later in the month as temporary ceasefire in the Middle East helped ease concerns about inflation.

managerCommentary.zh: 本基金於5月份錄得-0.59%回報。主要貢獻來自港元債券及減持香港股票策略。恒生指數在五月下跌了2.3%。但地產分類指數表現相對較好。根據差餉物業估價署的資料，香港四月份的房價按年上漲了10.5%，並升至兩年半以來的高位。恒生中國企業指數下跌了2.9%。儘管習特峰會未能達成聯合聲明，但兩國政府達成「建設性戰略穩定關係」的共識。五月份滬深300指數上升了1.8%。與人工智能相關的投資主題仍受投資者關注。科技分類指數上漲超過16%，電信服務分類指數則跳升了24%。中國經濟數據依然呈現出喜憂參半的情況。主要城市的房地產市場有回穩跡象，出口增長持續加快，官方製造業採購經理指數從四月的50.1於五月上升至50.5。然而，四月份零售銷售和工業生產的年度增速有所放緩。本月，香港政府港元債券收益率曲線跟隨美國國債收益率曲線而上行。就港元信貸而言，信用利差大致上收窄。踏入6月，在地緣政治局勢維持緊張、全球宏觀經濟發展以及美國政策不確定性的影響下，市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期不斷改變，港元債券收益率料將持續波動。同時，本港經濟情況及投資於股票或避險資產的港元資金流向亦會影響港元債券收益率。因此，中長期優質港元債券仍然是投資重點，以獲得具吸引力的回報，同時亦能減少利率波動對價格的負面影響。
managerCommentary.en: The fund recorded -0.59% return in May. The main contributors were HKD bonds and underweight in Hong Kong equities. The Hang Seng Index went down by 2.3% in May. The property sub-index continued to outperform. According to Rating and Valuation Department, home prices in Hong Kong jumped by 10.5% year-on-year in April and reached the highest level in two-and-a-half years. The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index lost 2.9%. Although the Xi-Trump summit did not conclude a joint declaration, both governments agree on “constructive strategic stability” between the two countries. The CSI 300 Index went up by 1.8% in May. Investor focus remained on Artificial Intelligence-related theme. The information technology sub-index surged more than 16% and the telecommunication services sub-index soared 24%. China’s economic data remained mixed. Property markets in China’s major cities showed sign of stabilization and export growth kept accelerating. The official Purchasing Managers Index increased to 50.5 in May from April’s 50.1. However, the yearly growth of retail sales and industrial production decelerated in April. Hong Kong government HKD bond yield curve shifted upwards in May, tracking the US Treasury yield curve. In terms of HKD credits, spreads generally tightened during the month. Going into June, HKD bond yields are expected to remain volatile amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, global macroeconomic development and US policies uncertainties, which influence market expectations on the US monetary decisions. Meanwhile, Hong Kong domestic economic conditions and HKD fund flows for equity investments or pursuit of haven assets also influence HKD bond yields. As such, medium to long term high-quality HKD bonds continue to be the investment focus for attractive return while minimising the negative price impact from interest rates fluctuations.

However, escalating protests in Iran and Chinese military exercises in the Taiwan Strait weighed on sentiment at month end. European stocks finished in front, followed closely by the UK. Japan was next but trailed the global index, while the US was roughly flat over the month. Emerging markets trailed their developed market peers, dragged lower by index heavyweight China. Overall, all three major US indices – the S&P 500 Index, the Dow Jones Industrial Average Index and the tech-heavy NASDAQ Composite Index – were roughly flat in December, with each index moving by -0.05%, 0.73% and -0.53% respectively. In Asia, the MSCI AC Asia Pacific index rose by 1.98%. The Hang Seng index saw slight weakness, falling by 0.88%, while the Shanghai Shenzhen CSI 300 index saw a gain of 2.28% over the month.

managerCommentary.en: Major central banks around the world were active in December. The US Federal Reserve (Fed) delivered a 25-basis point (bp) rate cut, bringing the federal funds rate to 3.5%–3.75%, the lowest level in three years. Similarly, the Bank of England lowered the base rate by 25 bps to 3.75% – also the lowest in three years. The ECB and People’s Bank of China both left their key borrowing rates unchanged. Japan remained an outlier, with the Bank of Japan (BoJ) delivering a 25-bp rate rise to 0.75% – the highest level since 1995 – amid rising inflation and continued yen weakness. Global bond yields inched higher over December. Global equities delivered a modest gain in December, with the MSCI All Country World Index (ACWI) rounding out an impressive rise of more than 20% for the year.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 美國股市在 12 月份微升，經濟數據欠佳導致投資情緒受壓。市場日益憧憬美國聯儲局減息而當局亦確實減息，帶動市場於月初上升。月內，對人工智能估值高企的憂慮再次浮現，投資者將資金輪轉至市場上估值較低的板塊。加勒比地區局勢日益緊張，引發市場對地區安全局勢的關注。另外，美國在尼日利亞西北部空襲伊斯蘭國，加上伊朗示威活動升級，以及中國舉行台海軍事演習，均導致市場情緒受壓。儘管宏觀經濟和地緣政治不確定性揮之不去，但俗稱的「聖誕老人行情」仍然在臨近年底帶動股市上升。美國債券市場在月內表現不一，國庫券及投資級別企業債券被拋售，而高收益債券則上漲。美國國庫券收益率曲線趨於傾斜。美國決策者對減息的決定存在意見分歧，而投資者亦日益擔憂總統特朗普很可能指派的下屆聯儲局主席人選。
managerCommentary.en: US equities rose fractionally in December, as lacklustre economic data weighed on sentiment. Markets rose early on amid growing hopes of a rate cut from the Federal Reserve (Fed), as duly transpired. As the month progressed, elevated AI valuation concerns resurfaced, with investors rotating into cheaper parts of the market. Flaring tensions in the Caribbean triggered concerns around regional security. Meanwhile, US strikes against the Islamic State in northwestern Nigeria dented sentiment, alongside escalating protests in Iran and Chinese military exercises in the Taiwan Strait. The so-called Santa Claus rally lifted stocks into year end despite lingering macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainties. It was a mixed month for US bonds, with Treasuries and investment-grade corporate bonds selling off, while high-yield bonds rose. The US Treasury yield curve steepened. US policymakers were divided over the decision to cut rates and there was increasing nervousness over President Donald Trump’s likely choice for the next Fed chair.

managerCommentary.en: US equities were flat in December, underperforming globally. Sector performance was mixed, with financials and materials leading. The Fed cut rates by 25bps to 3.5%–3.75%, citing US labour market weakness and easing inflation (2.7% in November). Unemployment rose to 4.6%, while job gains were modest. European equities gained over 2% in December, capping a strong year. Financials led performance, while energy and staples lagged. The European Central Bank kept rates at 2% for the fourth meeting, and projected inflation near its 2% target. Asia ex-Japan equities delivered mixed performances in December. Most regional markets including Taiwan, Korea, Malaysia and Thailand ended the year on a positive note, while China and India saw modest correction during the month.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 歐洲股市於 12 月強勢收官，歐元區市場上漲超過 2%，而英國的 FTSE All-Share指數更以全球表現最佳之一結束全年。金融類股領漲全歐洲，工業與非必需消費品亦提供支持；相反，受到油價走弱影響，能源與必需消費品類股表現落後。政策取態保持審慎：歐洲央行連續第四次會議維持利率在 2% 不變，強調在全球不確定性下需保持彈性；英國央行則以微弱票數通過減息 25 個基點至 3.75%，顯示未來政策路徑將更為微妙。市場預期，隨通脹持續接近目標水平，2026 年或將有進一步的溫和寬鬆。
managerCommentary.en: European equities ended December on a strong note, with Eurozone markets gaining over 2% and the UK’s FTSE All-Share closing the year as one of the best global performers. Financials led gains across the continent, supported by industrials and consumer discretionary, while energy and consumer staples lagged amid softer oil prices. Policy remained cautious: the ECB kept rates unchanged at 2% for a fourth straight meeting, emphasizing flexibility amid global uncertainty, while the Bank of England delivered a 25 bps cut to 3.75% in a narrow vote, signalling that future moves will be finely balanced. Markets expect further gradual easing in 2026 as inflation approaches target levels.

managerCommentary.zh: 中國和香港市場於 12 月經歷修正，健康護理及房地產行業月內表現遜色，原材料及工業以及金融業則錄得正回報。經濟方面，中國採購經理人指數於 12 月反彈至擴張區間，說明製造業活動勢頭稍有復甦。零售額於 11 月放緩，按年增幅降至1.3%。但受近期節慶活動及「光棍節」大促支持，2025 年 11 月份零售額仍錄得正面增長。政策方面，國家發展改革委及財政部於 12 月 30 日聯合發佈 2026 年以舊換新補貼計劃，同時下達首批人民幣 625 億元的資金支持。持續的補貼有望利好消費者相關行業並由此外溢至服務業。
managerCommentary.en: The China and Hong Kong market corrected in December, with healthcare and real estates lagged this month, while materials and industrials and financials returned positively. On economic front, the purchasing managers index of China bounced back to expansionary territory in December, reflecting manufacturing activity regained some momentum. Retail sales slowed in November, with year-over-year figure easing to 1.3%. Nevertheless, supported by recent festivities and Singles’ Day promotions which continue recorded a positive growth in November 2025.On policy front, on December 30, the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Finance announced the 2026 trade-in subsidies program and released the first batch of first-quarter funding—RMB62.5 billion. The continued subsidies are likely to support consumer-related sectors and spillover into services.

managerCommentary.heading: 評論 Commentary*
managerCommentary.zh: 於2026年第二季度，中國香港股市與環球主要股市走勢出現嚴重分化；當環球主要股市繼續受惠AI熱潮而上升之際，港股不單未能受惠，更是反覆偏軟。內地政府在2026年第二季度顯著加大了對非法資金外流的打擊力度，特別針對未經授權的跨境資金轉移，並嚴厲收緊中國內地居民在港開立銀行和證券賬戶的合規審查。這一監管風暴打擊了離岸中資散戶與投機資金的入市情緒，重創港股市場的流動性，是港股疲弱的主因。最終，生指數在2026年第二季度累計下跌7.7%，收報22,881.02點。內地加強監管違規資金及減息預期大降，料令港股短期走勢持續偏軟。不過始終港股估值偏低，可限制向下空間。然而要港股重拾升勢，需要有明確的催化因素，例如內地政府推出一些財政刺激方案以提振企業盈利。在2026年第二季度內，聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）繼續將聯邦基金利率的目標區間維持在3.50%至3.75%，保持其「觀望」的立場。鑑於持續的石油價格衝擊所帶來的次級通脹效應已進一步滲透至核心經濟指標，美國聯邦儲備局在會後聲明中持續發表鷹派言論。官員們承認通脹走向仍存在極大不確定性，令市場對年內減息的預期幻滅。在這情況下，相信利率將在「高位維持更長時間」，但今年轉為加息的機會應不大。
managerCommentary.en: In the second quarter of 2026, the China Hong Kong stock market experienced a sharp divergence from major global peers. While global equities continued to ride the AI-driven rally, China Hong Kong stocks failed to catch the tailwind, instead exhibiting persistent weakness. A primary drag on the market was Mainland China's intensified crackdown on illicit capital outflows during the second quarter of 2026. Targeting unauthorized cross-border fund transfers, authorities drastically tightened compliance screening for Mainland China residents opening bank and securities accounts in China Hong Kong. This regulatory clampdown severely dampened sentiment among offshore Mainland China retail and speculative investors, dealing a heavy blow to market liquidity and serving as the main reason for China Hong Kong's underperformance. Consequently, the Hang Seng Index dropped 7.7% in the second quarter of 2026, closing at 22,881.02. Looking ahead, tighter Mainland China scrutiny over illegal capital flows and no more rate-cut expectations will suppress China Hong Kong stock in short term. But relatively-low valuation should limit the downside of the market. For China Hong Kong equities to regain upward momentum, clear catalysts are needed–such as fiscal stimulus from Beijing to revive corporate earnings. The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) maintained its "wait-and-see" stance during the second quarter of 2026, holding the target range for the federal funds rate at 3.50% to 3.75%. As secondary inflationary pressures from persistent oil price shocks filtered into core economic indicators, the Federal Reserve maintained a hawkish tone in its post-meeting statements. Officials acknowledged deep uncertainty over the inflation trajectory, effectively shattering market hopes for rate cuts this year. Under these conditions, interest rates are expected to stay "higher for longer," though a pivot back to rate hikes this year remains unlikely.

managerCommentary.heading: 評論 Commentary*
managerCommentary.zh: 環球股市於2026年第二季度出現動盪。MSCI綜合世界指數大幅上升，但市場走勢深受中東局勢發展的影響，特別是德黑蘭能透過封鎖具有戰略意義的霍爾木茲海峽航道來干擾能源供應。整體而言，股市與油價走勢相反。當美國與伊朗、以色列與黎巴嫩之間的緊張局勢出現緩和跡象，加上結束衝突及重開海峽的斡旋日漸有望取得成功，油價便會回落而股市則上升。相反，每當敵對行動加劇或脆弱的停火協議可能破裂時，股市便會回落而油價則上升。但在2026年第二季度內後期，脆弱的和平協議似乎有望維持，有助提振市場情緒。同時，隨著取道霍爾木茲海峽的全球石油運輸恢復，油價從近期高位回落，帶動風險資產反彈。馬斯克的SpaceX在納斯達克首次公開上市並打破紀錄，進一步增強市場承險意欲，但對人工智能估值偏高及人工智能支出的擔憂不時重現，在季內稍後觸發以科技股為主的一連串回調。地域方面，日本是2026年第二季表現最佳的市場，美國及歐洲緊隨其後。期內，新興市場表現大幅跑贏已發展市場，科技樞紐南韓及中國台灣的升幅抵銷了指數比重較高的中國內地的顯著跌幅。MSCI綜合世界指數方面，資訊科技業是表現明顯最強的行業。工業及金融業亦在季內錄得強勁的雙位數升幅。負面消息方面，能源股大幅下跌，回吐早前的升勢，原因是波斯灣緊張局勢緩和，投資者看好取道海峽的油輪運輸將會恢復。其他方面，原物料及公用事業表現落後，但期內亦錄得輕微的正回報。伊朗戰爭導致能源成本飆升，使通脹前景面臨上行風險，而全球增長預測亦面臨下行風險。因此，面對地緣政治動盪和經濟不確定性加劇的背景，主要央行的貨幣政策制定者均持審慎態度。美國方面，聯邦儲備局（聯儲局）在2026年第二季度內維持聯邦基金利率於3.50%至3.75%的目標範圍不變。同時，特朗普總統提名的候選人沃什獲參議院確認為新任聯儲局主席，接替鮑威爾。沃什於2026年5月22日宣誓就職，並在聯儲局2026年6月份會議上首次在聯邦公開市場委員會正式現身。英倫銀行亦在期內維持基準利率不變；歐洲央行則在2026年6月份會議上宣佈加息25點子，是自2023年9月以來首次加息，將基準貸款利率上調至2.25%。日本央行亦上調利率25點子至1.0%，是31年來最高水平；中國人民銀行則在回顧期內維持貸款市場報價利率不變。外匯市場方面，美元在2026年第二季度內升值，但期內匯價反覆波動。美元在2026年4月份回軟，因市場初步看好雙邊會談有助為結束衝突鋪路。然而，由於市場擔心陷入長期僵局而導致避險情緒升溫，美元因避險需求而升值。由於敵對行動在2026年5月份再度升級，投資者在債券收益率飆升之際拋售風險資產，美元持續上升。其後，美國與伊朗達成和平協議的消息，加上霍爾木茲海峽的油輪運輸於2026年6月份恢復，帶動美元回落；然而，由於聯儲局「放鷹」，加上科技股大跌觸發投資者湧向避險資產，帶動美元在臨近2026年第二季度末升至十五個月高位。歐元及英鎊回吐初期的升幅，因美元在期內稍後轉強而回軟。英鎊方面，儘管2026年5月份的地方選舉及權力下放選舉的結果以及政府高層在2026年6月份的震盪均帶來政治不明朗因素，但英鎊兌美元在本季略為升值。另一方面，日圓曾在2026年4月底的貨幣干預措施實施後大幅升值，但在回顧期的剩餘時間，即使日本當局再度推出干預措施，但日圓直至季末仍然徘徊於40年低位以下。油價在2026年第二季度大幅下跌；當美伊在2026年6月中旬宣佈達成和平協議，以及具有戰略意義的霍爾木茲海峽恢復正常油輪運輸後，布蘭特原油價格逆轉升勢，大致回復至戰前水平。隨著各國補充早前大量消耗的儲備，預期油價將在未來數月維持在高位，但布蘭特原油價格在2026年第二季度內收於每桶73美元以上，已較衝突時期的高位下跌近40%。另外，金價在2026年第二季度內大幅下跌，由於能源價格急升引發對通脹升溫的憂慮，觸發加息預期，因此投資者將資金輪換至美元。聯儲局在期內稍後「放鷹」，使市場愈加擔憂政府官員將維持長期高息以對抗頑固的通脹，繼而導致金價進一步受壓，在月內收於略高於每盎司4,000美元的水平。
managerCommentary.en: The second quarter of 2026 was a turbulent period for global equities. The MSCI All Country World Index (ACWI) rose sharply but market movements were heavily influenced by developments in the Middle East, particularly Tehran’s ability to disrupt energy supplies through the strategically important Strait of Hormuz shipping lane. On the whole, equities moved inversely to oil prices, rallying as oil prices retreated on signs of de-escalating tensions between the US and Iran or Israel and Lebanon amid mounting optimism around diplomatic efforts to end the conflict and reopen the strait. Conversely, stocks retreated and oil prices rose whenever hostilities intensified or the fragile ceasefires looked at risk of breaking down. However, sentiment was bolstered later in the period as a fragile peace deal looked to be holding. Meanwhile, the resumption of global oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz saw risk assets rally as oil prices slumped from recent highs. The record-breaking Nasdaq debut of Elon Musk’s SpaceX further reinforced the risk-on mood, although renewed fears about lofty AI valuations and AI spending flared intermittently, triggering a series of tech-led pullbacks later in the period. Geographically, Japan was the strongest performer over the second quarter of 2026, closely followed by the US and Europe. Emerging markets trounced their developed market counterparts over the period, with gains from tech hubs South Korea and China Taiwan offsetting heavy losses from index heavyweight Mainland China. Turning to the MSCI ACWI, information technology was the strongest sector by some distance. Industrials and financials also posted robust double-digit gains over the quarter. Less positively, energy stocks plummeted, reversing previous gains as easing tensions in the Gulf boosted optimism about the resumption of tanker traffic through the strait. Elsewhere, materials and utilities underperformed, albeit finishing the period with fractionally positive returns. Soaring energy costs stemming from the war in Iran triggered upside risks to inflationary outlooks and downside risks to global growth forecasts. As a result, monetary policymakers at the key central banks struck a cautious note against a geopolitically volatile backdrop and heightened economic uncertainty. In the US, the Federal Reserve (Fed) held the federal funds rate steady at a target range of 3.50%–3.75% over the second quarter of 2026. Meanwhile, Kevin Warsh – US President Trump’s nominee to succeed Jerome Powell – was confirmed by the Senate to serve as the new Fed chair. He was sworn in on 22 May 2026 and made his formal debut on the Federal Open Market Committee at the US central bank’s 2026 June meeting. The Bank of England also left the base rate unchanged over the period, while the European Central Bank delivered a widely anticipated 25-basis-point (bps) rate hike at its 2026 June meeting – its first since September 2023 – bringing the benchmark lending rate to 2.25%. The Bank of Japan also raised rates by 25 bps to 1.0% – the highest level in 31 years – while the People’s Bank of China left its loan prime rates unchanged over the review period. In currency markets, the US dollar rose over the second quarter of 2026, but it was a volatile period. The greenback eased in April 2026 amid initial optimism that bilateral negotiations could pave the way towards an end to the conflict. However, the US currency rose on safe-haven demand as fears of a prolonged stalemate prompted a bout of risk aversion. The dollar continued its ascent as hostilities re-escalated in May 2026, with investors dumping risk assets against a backdrop of spiking bond yields. News that the US and Iran had agreed a peace deal and the resumption of tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz in June 2026 drove the greenback lower, although hawkish commentary from the Fed and a flight to safety triggered by a major tech-stock rout lifted the dollar to a 15-month high near the end of the second quarter of 2026. The euro and the British pound gave back early gains, weakening as the dollar strengthened later in the period. The pound finished the second quarter of 2026 fractionally up against the greenback, despite being buffeted by political uncertainty after local and devolved election results in May 2026 and leadership turmoil in June 2026. Meanwhile, following a sharp uptick on the back of currency intervention measures at the end April 2026, the Japanese yen weakened over the rest of the review period, hovering beyond 40-year lows into quarter end despite renewed intervention measures from the Japanese authorities. Oil prices plummeted over the second quarter of 2026, with Brent crude reversing gains and broadly reverting to pre-war levels following the mid-June 2026 announcement of a US-Iran peace deal and the resumption of normalised tanker traffic through the strategically important Strait of Hormuz. While oil prices are expected to remain elevated over the coming months as countries replenish heavily depleted stockpiles, Brent crude closed the quarter above USD 73 a barrel, down almost 40% from conflict highs. Meanwhile, gold prices fell sharply over the second quarter of 2026, with investors rotating into the US dollar as spiking energy prices stoked concerns about upside inflationary risks, triggering expectations of higher interest rates. Hawkish Fed commentary later in the period fuelled fears that policymakers will keep interest rates higher for longer in a bid to tame sticky inflation, further pressuring gold prices, with the yellow metal closing the month just above USD 4,000 an ounce.

managerCommentary.heading: 評論 Commentary*
managerCommentary.zh: 環球股市於2026年第二季度上揚。主要驅動因素是人工智能及相關資本投資週期持續走強，提振科技股佔比較高的市場，以及深耕半導體及先進電子品供應鏈的經濟體。環球政府債券市場表現出現分歧。日本及美國整體表現落後；歐元區方面，德國表現落後於非核心及外圍市場，而希臘表現最強勁。2026年第二季度內，中東的地緣政治緊張局勢引發了間歇性的市場波動。美伊宣布達成停火框架並簽署諒解備忘錄，市場對衝突擴大的擔憂有所緩解。隨著有關全球能源供應持續中斷的憂慮減弱，能源價格回落，投資者情緒亦見改善。
managerCommentary.en: Global equities gained in the second quarter of 2026. The dominant driver was continued momentum in artificial intelligence and related capital investment cycles, which strengthened technology-heavy markets and economies that are embedded in semiconductor and advanced electronics supply chains. Performance diverged across global government bond markets. Japan and the US underperformed overall, while within the eurozone Germany lagged non-core and peripheral markets, with Greece the strongest performer. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East added intermittent volatility during the second quarter of 2026. The announcement of a US–Iran ceasefire framework and a memorandum of understanding eased concerns about a broader regional conflict. Energy prices retreated and investor sentiment improved as fears of a sustained disruption to global energy supplies diminished.

managerCommentary.heading: 評論 Commentary*
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，亞太區（日本除外）股票表現異常強勁，富時強積金亞太區（日本除外）指數以港元計上升22.9%，主要受惠於科技板塊持續強勢，以及市場對人工智能投資週期的樂觀情緒。2026年4月及2026年5月市場大幅反彈，中東地緣政治局勢緩和、半導體及人工智能供應鏈企業於2026年第一季盈利強勁，加上美國超大型雲端營運商加大資本開支承諾，均提振了投資者信心，尤以南韓及中國台灣地區市場表現突出。雖然美國國債孳息率上升及通脹憂慮引發週期性波動，但科技板塊的盈利上調持續為市場動能提供支撐。2026年6月，市場因憂慮人工智能開支的可持續性、美元走強及美國聯邦儲備局（聯儲局）立場轉趨鷹派，而出現部分獲利回吐及整固。與此同時，中國內地及中國香港期內表現落後，因中國內地經濟數據仍然疲弱。此外，跨境資金管制的加強亦打擊了市場情緒。大宗商品市場表現波動，布蘭特原油在2026年4月因美伊緊張局勢而飆升至每桶110美元以上，其後隨霍爾木茲海峽重開及地緣政治風險緩和，於2026年第二季末回落至約每桶73美元。板塊方面，資訊科技股在人工智能及數據中心需求持續支持下，成為全季表現最突出的行業；工業及金融板塊亦跑贏大市；而通訊服務及非必需消費品板塊則表現落後。超配南韓及低配印度和澳洲的部署帶來正面貢獻。在中國台灣、中國香港及中國內地的選股，為基金跑贏大市的主要驅動力。主要貢獻來自我們在這些地區的科技板塊持倉。建滔積層板因人工智能相關的銅箔及電子級玻璃纖維布供應短缺而持續加價，帶動其股價在2026年第二季度以港元計飆升五倍。台光電子材料受惠於市場預期覆銅板將進一步加價，繼續跑贏大市，因為人工智能印刷電路板需求非常強勁，但組件供應受限。北方華創的股價表現受惠於市場對全球記憶體行業的樂觀情緒，以及中國內地先進記憶體行業資本開支不斷增長。資訊科技板塊內的選股貢獻了最大增值。另一主要貢獻股份為南亞塑膠，其股價期內升逾一倍，受惠於人工智能對電子材料的強勁需求推動盈利增長加快，進而帶動產品加價及經營利潤率擴張的潛力。期內，印度及新加坡的選股是拖累表現的主要因素，主要由於投資組合中未有納入新加坡銀行股及印度工業股。通訊服務及非必需消費品板塊的選股帶來負面貢獻。在非必需消費品板塊中，銀河娛樂股價下跌，因市場憂慮競爭加劇及利潤率下降。另一主要拖累股份為友邦保險，其股價在監管機構加強跨境資金管制後遭遇拋售，並引發市場對其中國內地訪客保險業務的監管憂慮。投資組合在風險取態上保持均衡。我們對半導體、零部件及精選工業股維持正面看法。我們將繼續維持多元化投資組合，並專注於具優質增長、高自由現金流及／或資本管理持續改善的企業。我們偏好涉及國防及電力設備領域的科技和工業股。
managerCommentary.en: Asia Pacific ex Japan equities delivered an exceptionally strong performance in the second quarter of 2026, with the FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex Japan Index rising 22.9% in HKD terms, driven primarily by the continued strength of the technology sector and optimism surrounding the AI investment cycle. Markets rallied sharply in April 2026 and May 2026 as easing Middle East geopolitical tensions, strong first-quarter of 2026 earnings from semiconductor and AI supply chain companies, and increased capital expenditure commitments from US hyperscalers boosted investor confidence, particularly in Korea and China Taiwan. While rising US Treasury yields and inflation concerns caused periodic volatility, earnings upgrades across the technology sector continued to support market momentum. In June 2026, markets consolidated some of their gains amid concerns over the sustainability of AI spending, a stronger US dollar, and a more hawkish US Federal Reserve stance. Meanwhile, Mainland China and China Hong Kong underperformed during the second quarter of 2026 as Mainland China domestic economic data remained weak. Moreover, the step up in cross-border-capital controls also weighs on market sentiment. Commodity markets were volatile, with Brent crude oil surging above US$110/bbl in April 2026 amid US-Iran tensions before retreating to approximately US$73/bbl by quarter-end following the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and easing geopolitical risks. Sector-wise, Information Technology was the standout performer throughout the quarter, supported by persistent AI and data-centre demand, while Industrials and Financials also outperformed, whereas Communication Services and Consumer Discretionary lagged the broader market. The overweight in South Korea and underweight in India and Australia contributed positively. The stock selection in China Taiwan, China Hong Kong and Mainland China drove the bulk of the outperformance of the fund. Notable contributors were our holdings in technology sector in these countries. Continuous price hikes by Kingboard Laminates due to shortage in AI related copper foil and e-glass fabric led to a 5-fold increase in share price in the second quarter of 2026 in HKD terms. Elite Material continued to outperform the market on the back of expectations of more copper clad laminates (CCL) price hikes since AI Printed Circuit Board demand has been very robust, but supply of components is constrained. Naura’s share price performance was buoyed by the optimism on the global memory sector as well as growing capex spend by Mainland China advanced memory industry. The stock selection in Information Technology added the most value. The other notable contributor is Nan Ya Plastics, whose share price more than doubled during the second quarter of 2026 on the back of accelerating earnings growth driven by strong AI demand for electronic materials, leading to price hikes and potential operating profit margin expansion. The stock selection within India and Singapore was the main drag on performance during the second quarter of 2026, mainly due to the absence of Singapore banks and Indian Industrials companies in the portfolio. Stock selection within Communication Services and Consumer Discretionary sectors contributed negatively. Within Consumer Discretionary sector, share price of Galaxy Entertainment declined as there were concerns on market competition and lower margins. The other notable detractor is AIA Group whose share price suffered a sell-off after there was a step up in cross border capital controls by the authorities and triggered regulatory fears around its Mainland China Visitor insurance business. The portfolio is balanced in terms of risk posture. We remain constructive on semiconductors, components, and selective industrials. We will continue to hold a diversified portfolio and focus on companies with quality growth, high free cashflow, and/or improving capital management. We prefer technology and industrials with exposure to defense, and power equipment.

managerCommentary.heading: 評論 Commentary*
managerCommentary.zh: 美國聯邦儲備局（聯儲局）於 2026 年 6 月會議宣佈維持利率在3.50% - 3.75%不變。新任主席沃什強調物價過高，將堅守2%通脹目標且拒絕提供前瞻指引；點陣圖則顯示多數官員預計今年至少加息一次。儘管今年前四次會議並未加息，但市場預期已從2026年初的「轉向降息」變為「至少再加息0.25%」。受此影響，3個月香港銀行同業拆息（HIBOR）由2026年第一季末的2.36%回升至2026年第二季末的2.97%，與美息距離逐漸收窄。除非聯儲局再度大幅加息，否則HIBOR大幅上行的空間有限。
managerCommentary.en: The U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) announced at its June 2026 meeting that it would maintain the federal funds rate unchanged at 3.50%-3.75%. The newly appointed Chairman, Kevin Warsh, emphasized that prices remain elevated, reaffirming a commitment to the 2% inflation target while declining to provide forward guidance. Meanwhile, the latest dot plot revealed that a majority of officials expect at least one rate hike this year. Although the Fed held rates steady during the first four meetings of the year 2026, market expectations have significantly shifted from a 'pivot to rate cuts' at the beginning of the year 2026 to 'at least one more 25-basis-point hike.' Driven by this shift, the 3-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate (HIBOR) rebounded from 2.36% at the end of the first quarter of 2026 to 2.97% at the end of the second quarter of 2026, gradually narrowing its spread with U.S. interest rates. Barring further aggressive hikes by the Fed, the room for HIBOR to move substantially higher remains limited.

investmentObjective.heading: 投資目標 Investment Objective
investmentObjective.zh: 基金的目標是透過主要投資於中國香港股票市場，以達致長線的資本增長。
investmentObjective.en: The objective of the Fund is to achieve capital growth over the long-term by investing mainly in Hong Kong equity markets.

managerCommentary.heading: 評論 Commentary*
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，香港股票的基準—富時強積金香港指數回報為-6.5%。季內，資訊科技、金融及工業板塊表現優於指數，而能源、原材料及非必需消費品板塊則表現落後。2026年第二季度，中國香港的經濟活動在季末出現輕微復甦。香港標普全球採購經理人指數(PMI)由2026年5月份的50.4升至2026年6月份的52.0。2026年5月份出口增長由2026年4月份的42.9%放緩至40.8%，進口增長也由44.4%回落至42.0%。2026年5月份官方消費物價指數為2.0%。2026年5月份零售銷售以價值計增長7.9%，以數量計增長4.8%。儘管2026年第二季度出口導向型行業出現回穩跡象，中國內地經濟動能仍然偏軟。中國內地官方製造業PMI由2026年5月份的50.0升至2026年6月份的50.3，進一步進入擴張區間。2026年6月份出口按年增長由5月份的4.8%加快至5.8%，進口按年增長則由2026年5月份的-3.4%改善至1.1%。2026年5月份工業生產按年增長亦由2026年4月份的4.1%增強至4.5%，社會融資規模總額達人民幣2.03萬億元，高於市場預期的人民幣1.87萬億元。然而，大部分改善似乎由外部需求及出口相關活動所帶動。內部需求仍然疲弱，2026年5月份零售銷售按年收縮0.6%，扭轉此前數月的增長勢頭，亦低於市場預期。我們亦觀察到多個行業（如汽車消費）需求轉弱，顯示內地經濟的基礎復甦仍面臨挑戰。2026年4月份，中國內地及香港股票的風險偏好回升。在美伊停火後，股市強勁反彈，人工智能基礎設施受益股的漲幅顯著加快。另外，DeepSeek-V4進一步驗證了國產算力在大規模人工智能模型的應用，並強化了國產替代的趨勢。2026年5月份，市場仍緊扣人工智能主題，惟領漲範圍日益收窄，且集中度進一步提升。相比之下，平台互聯網股難以發力，市場情緒因人工智能變現前景不明而受壓。在科技板塊以外，市場未見預期中的流動性外溢至更廣泛的週期性股份，因為內地經濟活動放緩及盈利表現欠佳，打擊了投資者信心。2026年6月份，中國內地及香港股票因投資者獲利了結而大幅調整。儘管PMI數據改善且出口增長穩健，但估值憂慮以及人工智能和科技龍頭股的持倉擁擠，令市場情緒受壓。隨著中國內地內需轉弱，我們的策略轉向略為防守。我們繼續增持人工智能相關行業的股份，例如聯想及建滔集團。我們亦加入了與全球電氣化趨勢相關的股份，如安克創新及特銳德。由於增長放緩，我們減持了部分股份，例如阿里巴巴。香港經濟正在復甦，但由於本地與全球經濟前景充滿挑戰，仍面臨部分不利因素，因此我們對香港企業維持中性立場。由於增長放緩，我們減持了友邦保險的部分持倉。2026年第二季度，儘管中東局勢緩和及油價下跌，中國內地及香港股票仍表現落後。在內需疲弱、消費數據偏軟，以及市場對盈利增長可持續性的憂慮下，投資者情緒仍然審慎。我們對中國內地及香港股票維持審慎樂觀的看法。製造業活動改善、出口表現穩健，以及市場對進一步政策支持的預期，應可提供有利的宏觀背景。
managerCommentary.en: In the second quarter of 2026, the FTSE MPF Hong Kong Index, the benchmark of the Hong Kong Equity Fund, returned -6.5%. Information technology, financials and industrials sectors outperformed the index, while energy, materials and consumer discretionary sectors lagged during the quarter. In the second quarter of 2026, China Hong Kong’s economics activities slightly recovered towards the end of the quarter. Hong Kong S&P Global Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) increased to 52.0 in June 2026 from 50.4 in May 2026. Export growth moderated to 40.8% in May 2026 versus 42.9% in April 2026, while import growth eased to 42.0% from 44.4%. Official CPI was 2.0% in May 2026. Retail sales growth was 7.9% in terms of value and 4.8% in volume terms in May 2026. Mainland China's domestic economic momentum remained soft despite signs of stabilization in export-oriented sectors in the second quarter of 2026. Mainland China's official Manufacturing PMI increased to 50.3 in June 2026 from 50.0 in May 2026, moving further into expansion territory. Export growth accelerated to 5.8% year-over-year in June 2026 from 4.8% in May 2026, while import growth improved to 1.1% year-over-year from -3.4% in May 2026. Industrial production growth also strengthened to 4.5% year-over-year in May 2026 from 4.1% in April 2026, and total social financing reached RMB 2.03 trillion, exceeding market expectations of RMB 1.87 trillion. However, much of the improvement appears to have been driven by external demand and export-related activities. Domestic demand remained weak, with retail sales contracting 0.6% year-over-year in May 2026, a reversal from previous months' growth and below market expectations. We also saw a weakening demand across several domestic sectors (e.g. auto consumption), which suggests that the underlying recovery in the domestic economy continues to face challenges. In April 2026, risk appetite rebounded across Mainland China and Hong Kong equities. Following the US-Iran ceasefire, equities staged a strong comeback, with gains accelerating sharply across AI infra beneficiaries. Separately, DeepSeek-V4 further validates domestic compute for large-scale AI models and reinforces the trajectory of domestic substitution. In May 2026, the market remained firmly anchored by the AI narrative, though the leadership became increasingly narrow and concentrated. In contrast, platform internet struggled to gain traction, with sentiment capped by uncertain AI monetization. Beyond tech, the market failed to see the anticipated liquidity spillover into broader cyclicals, as softening domestic activity and lackluster earnings delivery weighed on investor confidence. In June 2026, Mainland China and Hong Kong equities corrected sharply as investors took profits. Despite improving Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data and resilient export growth, sentiment was pressured by valuation concerns, crowded positioning in AI and technology leaders. Our strategy turned slightly defensive as Mainland China domestic demand weakened. We continued to increase our position in AI related industry, such as Lenovo and Kingboard. We also added names related to global electrification trend, like Anker and TGood. We reduced some positions in names like Alibaba due to weakening growth. China Hong Kong’s economy is recovering but still facing some headwind due to challenging economic outlook both domestically and globally, thus we retain a neutral position in China Hong Kong companies. We reduced some positions in AIA as the growth has slowed down. In the second quarter of 2026, Mainland China and Hong Kong equities underperformed despite the easing of Middle East tensions and lower oil prices. Investor sentiment remained cautious amid weak domestic demand, soft consumption data, and concerns over the sustainability of earnings growth. We remain cautiously constructive on Mainland China and Hong Kong equities. Improving manufacturing activity, resilient exports, and expectations for further policy support should provide a supportive backdrop.

investmentObjective.zh: 基金之目標是提供緊貼有關指ESG增強指數表現的投資成績（扣除費用及開支前）。

managerCommentary.heading: 評論 Commentary*
managerCommentary.zh: 回顧2026年第二季度，港股市場整體震盪走低。港股市場表現，主要受全球金融條件、中國內地宏觀經濟與政策環境及港股市場資金供求變化等因素綜合影響。全球金融條件方面，美國聯邦儲備局（聯儲局）於2026年4月及2026年6月議息會議均維持利率不變，聯邦基金利率目標區間保持3.50%-3.75%。2026年6月點陣圖顯著轉鷹，半數投票委員預計2026年內存在加息可能，美元流動性寬鬆預期持續受挫；10年期美債收益率高位震盪，美元指數走強，港元在聯繫匯率制度下承壓，本地流動性環境趨緊。中國內地宏觀經濟形勢方面，2026年第二季度經濟呈弱修復格局。物價方面，消費者物價指數(CPI)在2026年第一季度階段性衝高後走勢趨穩，核心通脹總體維持低位運行；生產者物價指數(PPI)延續2026年第一季度修復趨勢由負轉正，2026年5月受國際能源價格支撐漲幅擴大，但內需偏弱導致上下游產業傳導不暢。房地產市場調整壓力仍存，投資與銷售端繼續承壓；製造業採購經理人指數(PMI)在2026年第一季度末重返榮枯線後修復放緩，2026年5月回落至臨界點，內需復甦基礎仍待鞏固。政策層面，2026年4月中央政治局會議明確穩定和增強資本市場信心，實施更加積極的財政政策，著力擴大內需、推動消費升級；資本市場深化改革持續推進，助力現代化產業體系建設，鞏固市場長期發展根基。資金與市場情緒方面，南向資金延續淨流入態勢，截至2026年第二季度末年內累計淨買入超3000億港元，結構性增配科技賽道；外資受海外流動性收緊與風險偏好擾動，配置意願趨於謹慎。季內市場結構性分化顯著：資訊科技板塊受益於人工智能硬件景氣提升領漲；原材料、消費板塊受內需修復偏弱拖累領跌。展望未來，地緣局勢演進、通脹與就業數據及美聯儲政策轉向時點仍是短期市場關注焦點。從中長期來看，港股市場走勢將回歸經濟基本面，需重點關注政策措施的實際效果。儘管未來存在諸多不確定因素，當前港股市場的估值相較於全球主要市場仍具吸引力，若後續政策加碼與經濟持續改善形成共振，有望提供較佳的中長期投資機會。
managerCommentary.en: In the second quarter of 2026, the Hong Kong stock market broadly trended lower amid volatility. The market’s performance was primarily driven by a combination of global financial conditions, Mainland China’s macroeconomic and policy environment, and shifts in the supply and demand of capital within the Hong Kong market. Regarding global financial conditions, the Federal Reserve (Fed) maintained interest rates at both its April 2026 and June 2026 meetings, keeping the target range for the federal funds rate at 3.50%–3.75%. The June 2026 dot plot turned significantly hawkish, with half of the voting members expecting a potential rate hike within the year 2026, continuously dampening expectations for USD liquidity easing. The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield oscillated at high levels while the U.S. Dollar Index strengthened, putting pressure on the Hong Kong dollar under the linked exchange rate system and leading to tighter local liquidity conditions. Regarding Mainland China’s macroeconomic environment, the economy showed a weak recovery pattern during the second quarter of 2026. In terms of prices, after a periodic surge in the first quarter of 2026, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) stabilized, while core inflation generally remained at low levels. The Producer Price Index (PPI) extended its recovery trend from the first quarter of 2026 and turned positive, with its increase expanding in May 2026 supported by international energy prices; however, weak domestic demand resulted in sluggish pass-through between upstream and downstream sectors. The real estate market continued to face adjustment pressures, with both investment and sales remaining under strain. After returning to expansionary territory at the end of the first quarter of 2026, the recovery of the manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) slowed down, falling back to the boom-bust threshold in May 2026, indicating that the foundation for domestic demand recovery has yet to be consolidated. On the policy front, the April 2026 meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee explicitly highlighted stabilizing and enhancing capital market confidence, implementing more proactive fiscal policies, and focusing on expanding domestic demand to promote consumption upgrades. Comprehensive reforms in the capital market were continuously advanced, helping the construction of a modern industrial system and solidifying the foundation for long-term market development. In terms of flows and market sentiment, southbound capital maintained a trend of net inflows, with year-to-date cumulative net purchases exceeding HKD 300 billion by the end of the second quarter of 2026, structurally increasing allocations to the tech sector. Foreign investors remained cautious in their allocations, disturbed by overseas liquidity tightening and risk appetite. During the quarter, market performance showed significant structural divergence: the Information Technology sector led gains, benefiting from the rising prosperity of AI hardware, while the Materials and Consumer sectors led losses, dragged down by the weak recovery in domestic demand. Looking ahead, the evolution of geopolitical situations, inflation and employment data, and the timing of the Fed’s policy pivot remain the focus of short-term market attention. Over the medium to long term, the Hong Kong stock market is expected to align with economic fundamentals, with a focus on the tangible impact of policy measures. Despite various uncertainties, Hong Kong stocks remain attractively valued compared to major global markets. If stronger policies and continuous economic improvement create synergy, the market could offer compelling medium- to long-term investment opportunities.

managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度的市場特徵是波動顯著加劇，投資者持續重新評估不斷演變的美國與伊朗衝突，以及其可能透過霍爾木茲海峽（全球石油市場的重要運輸航道）對全球能源供應造成的影響。市場憂慮能源供應短缺、能源價格上升，以及地緣政治緊張局勢可能進一步升級，導致投資者風險趨避情緒在各類資產市場中週期性上升。這些發展進一步加劇了市場原本對通脹、經濟增長前景及未來貨幣政策走向的不確定性。
managerCommentary.en: The second quarter of 2026 was characterised by heightened market volatility as investors continually reassessed the implications of the evolving US-Iran conflict and the potential disruption to global energy supplies through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical shipping route for global oil markets. Concerns over supply shortages, higher energy prices and the potential for a broader escalation in geopolitical tensions drove periodic increases in risk aversion across asset markets. These developments added to existing uncertainty surrounding inflation, economic growth and the future path of monetary policy.

managerCommentary.heading: 評論 Commentary*
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年的過去三個月，中國A股表現再次優於離岸市場。事實上，中國內地股市在過去一年最突出的特徵之一就是A股持續強勢，而中國香港市場的表現則明顯相對疲弱。期內，MSCI中國A股在岸指數的回報超過40%，以離岸市場為主的MSCI中國指數則錄得負回報。雖然在岸與離岸市場出現分歧的情況並不罕見，但這是接近十年以來最大的表現落差，值得注意。我們認為，其原因主要是基本面有變，以及資金流動方向和價格衝擊。另一方面，中國台灣股市在季內強勢造好，主要由半導體及人工智能相關龍頭股的升勢所帶動。
managerCommentary.en: The last three months of 2026 was another period where China A shares outperformed offshore markets. Indeed, one of the most striking features of Mainland China equities over the past year has been the sustained strength of A-shares, in stark contrast to the much weaker performance in China Hong Kong. Over this period, the MSCI China A Onshore Index has delivered returns of more than 40%, while the offshore-dominated MSCI China Index is in negative territory. While periods of divergence between onshore and offshore markets are not uncommon, the magnitude of the current gap is notable and represents the widest dispersion in close to a decade. In our view, the reasons lie primarily in a combination of shifting fundamentals as well as the direction of fund flows and price shocks. On the other hand, China Taiwan equities rallied strongly over the quarter, driven by gains in major semiconductor and AI-related stocks.

Performance was more mixed in June 2026, with European and UK equities advancing while US markets pulled back after a period of strong performance.

managerCommentary.heading: 評論 Commentary*
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，中東霍爾木茲海峽航運擾動成為擾動美國經濟運行的關鍵外生變數。地緣緊張推升國際油價中樞，抬升輸入型通脹壓力，疊加AI產業鏈擴張帶來的內需韌性，通脹回落進程明顯放緩，市場對高利率長期化的定價進一步強化。宏觀經濟指標方面，美國2026年第二季度國內生產總值(GDP)增速仍具韌性，但整體增速較2026年第一季度邊際放緩；核心個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)年化增速持續高於美國聯邦儲備局（聯儲局）的2%政策目標，通脹粘性仍是政策核心約束。製造業採購經理人指數(PMI)延續邊際回暖，工業生產與新訂單回升印證企業投資意願修復；勞動力市場溫和降溫態勢延續，失業率維持4.3%左右低位，就業供需格局逐步回歸均衡。貨幣政策方面，聯儲局於2026年4月及2026年6月議息會議均維持利率不變，聯邦基金利率目標區間保持3.50%-3.75%。2026年6月最新點陣圖呈現顯著鷹派轉向，半數投票委員預計年內存在加息可能；會議聲明刪除“寬鬆偏向”表述並取消常規前瞻指引，新任主席沃什強調數據依賴與抗通脹優先目標。面對能源價格衝擊與通脹反彈風險的雙重挑戰，聯儲局政策觀望週期進一步拉長，邊際收緊預期顯著升溫。資本市場表現方面，2026年第二季度美股市場先揚後抑、結構分化加劇，板塊輪動節奏明顯提速。在此背景下，以美元計價的標普500指數在報告期內收漲15.10%。展望後市，短期市場核心聚焦聯儲局政策轉向節奏、通脹與就業數據邊際變化及人工智能資本開支落地進度。中長期來看，美股市場是全球資本市場重要的組成部分，也是美國家庭財富管理和海外投資者進行全球資產配置的核心載體。標普500指數的成份股公司多為各行業全球龍頭，具備較強盈利韌性與核心競爭壁壘。在中長期維度上，標普500指數歷史表現持續顯著跑贏美國名義GDP增速，中長期配置價值凸顯，未來仍將是分享美股優質資產中長期成長機遇的核心投資工具。
managerCommentary.en: In the second quarter of 2026, shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz in the Middle East emerged as a key exogenous variable disrupting U.S. economic performance. Geopolitical tensions pushed up the median of international oil prices, elevating imported inflation pressure, which, combined with domestic demand resilience brought about by the expansion of the AI industry chain, significantly slowed the process of disinflation and further reinforced market pricing for prolonged high interest rates. Regarding macroeconomic indicators, U.S. Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth in the second quarter of 2026 remained resilient, but the overall growth rate slowed marginally compared to the first quarter of 2026; the annualized core Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index (PCE) growth rate continued to exceed the Federal Reserve's (Fed) 2% policy target, with inflation stickiness remaining the core constraint on policy. Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) continued its marginal recovery, with rebounds in industrial production and new orders confirming a repair in corporate investment intentions. The labor market maintained its trend of modest cooling, with the unemployment rate remaining at a low level of around 4.3%, and the supply-demand balance in employment gradually returning to equilibrium. On monetary policy, the Fed maintained interest rates at both its April 2026 and June 2026 meetings, keeping the federal funds rate target range at 3.50%–3.75%. The latest dot plot in June 2026 presented a significantly hawkish shift, with half of the voting members expecting a potential rate hike within the year 2026; the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statement removed the wording regarding an "easing bias" and eliminated routine forward guidance, while the new Chair, Warsh, emphasized data dependence and the primary goal of fighting inflation. Facing the dual challenges of energy price shocks and the risk of an inflation rebound, the Fed's policy "wait-and-see" cycle was further extended, and expectations for marginal tightening heated up significantly. In capital market performance, the U.S. stock market rose before falling in the second quarter of 2026, with structural divergence intensifying and sector rotation accelerating noticeably. Against this backdrop, the S&P 500 Index, denominated in U.S. dollars, closed up 15.10% during the reporting period. Looking ahead, the pace of the Fed's policy pivot, marginal changes in inflation and employment data, and the execution progress of AI capital expenditure remain the focus of short-term market attention. Over the medium to long term, the U.S. stock market is a vital component of the global capital market and a core vehicle for household wealth management and global asset allocation for overseas investors. Most S&P 500 constituent companies are global leaders in their respective industries, possessing strong earnings resilience and core competitive moats. Over longer horizons, the historical performance of the S&P 500 has consistently and significantly outperformed U.S. nominal GDP growth. Its long-term allocation value remains prominent, and it will continue to be a core investment tool for sharing in the long-term growth opportunities of high-quality U.S. equity assets.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 政府債券市場在第二季整體造好，但表現仍然波動，收益率跟隨能源價格波動。表現方面，彭博美國國庫券總回報指數上升0.3%，表現遜於歐元區國庫券（升1.9%）及英國金邊債券（升2.1%）。新興市場債券表現出色，彭博新興市場本幣債券指數上升2.80%。儘管經濟增長風險依然存在，但各國央行越來越不願意「忽視」通脹衝擊。聯儲局維持利率於3.50%至 3.75%，沃什於 6月接任領導層，有助鞏固市場對政策將保持緊縮但不會機械式收緊的預期。歐洲央行在6月加息25個基點至 2.25%，理由是通脹高於目標及能源帶動價格壓力，同時亦上調通脹預測並下調增長預測。英倫銀行維持利率於3.75%不變，金邊債券受國內政治發展影響，包括首相施紀賢辭職。日本央行加息25個基點至1.00%，抵制日圓持續貶值。
managerCommentary.en: Government bond markets were positive overall but remained volatile in Q2, with yields tracking energy price swings. In terms of performance, the Bloomberg US Treasury Total Return Index added +0.3%, underperforming both euro treasuries (+1.9%) and UK gilts (+2.1%). Emerging market bonds outperformed, with the Bloomberg EM Local Currency Index returning +2.80%. Central banks were becoming less willing to “look through” inflation shocks despite lingering growth risks. The Federal Reserve held rates at 3.50%-3.75%, with Kevin Warsh’s leadership transition in June anchoring expectations of a restrictive but non-mechanical policy stance. The European Central Bank raised rates by 25 bps to 2.25% in June, citing above-target inflation and energy-driven price pressures, while also revising inflation forecasts higher and trimming growth projections. The Bank of England held rates unchanged at 3.75%, with gilts influenced by domestic political developments including PM Keir Starmer’s resignation. The Bank of Japan raised rates by 25 bps to 1.00%, to resist the continued depreciation of the yen.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 環球股票在2026年第二季報升，原因是投資者傾向看好由人工智能相關的半導體和數據基建供應鏈，以及美國與伊朗宣布停火框架，有助降低市場對局勢升級的憂慮，促使油價回落，並帶動風險偏好重估。領漲動力仍集中於增長股及受惠於人工智能的市場，亞洲及科技比重較高的地區普遍領先。固定收益市場整體錄得正回報，惟各國央行繼續收緊政策：歐洲央行及日本央行各自加息25個基點，而聯儲局在新任主席沃什（Kevin Warsh）領導下維持利率不變。信貸市場繼續獲得良好支持，隨著息差收窄，投資級別債券表現優於政府債券。新興市場資產表現顯著優於已發展市場，尤其是北亞股票及本幣債券。
managerCommentary.en: Global equities rose in Q2 2026, as investors leaned into the AI-driven capex cycle and the associated semiconductor and data-infrastructure supply chain. The announcement of a US–Iran ceasefire framework helped reduce escalation fears, contributing to a pullback in oil prices and a rerating of risk appetite. Leadership remained concentrated in growth and AI-exposed markets, with broad outperformance from Asia and technology-heavy regions. Fixed income markets delivered positive returns overall, though central banks continued to tighten: the ECB and Bank of Japan each raised rates by 25 bps, while the Federal Reserve held steady under new Chair Kevin Warsh. Credit markets remained well supported, with investment-grade and high-yield bonds outperforming government bonds as spreads tightened. Emerging market assets, particularly North Asian equities, and local-currency bonds, significantly outperformed developed markets.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: MSCI綜合世界指數第二季大幅上升14.5%，但市場走勢深受中東局勢發展的影響。整體而言，股市與油價走勢相反。但在季內後期，脆弱的和平協議似乎有望維持，隨著取道霍爾木茲海峽的全球石油運輸恢復，有助提振市場情緒。SpaceX在納斯達克首次公開上市，進一步增強市場承險意欲，但對人工智能估值偏高及支出的擔憂不時重現。隨著投資者應對中東地緣政治局勢發展，以及通脹預期和貨幣政策預期出現轉變，第二季美國國債波動加劇。市場關注財政赤字、國債供應增加及持續通脹風險，令整體國債收益率上揚。聯儲局在季內維持利率不變，但維持相對鷹派的立場，暗示對放寬政策持審慎態度。因此，美國國債收益率曲線在期內出現「熊市趨平」，10年期美國國債收益率在季內從4.32%上升至4.47%。
managerCommentary.en: The MSCI All Country World Index (ACWI) rose sharply for 14.5% in Q2, but market movements were heavily influenced by developments in the Middle East. However, sentiment was bolstered later in the period as a fragile peace deal looked to be holding, also the resumption of global oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz. The SpaceX IPO further reinforced the risk-on mood, although renewed fears about lofty AI valuations and spending flared intermittently. US Treasury experienced heightened volatility in Q2, as investors navigated geopolitical developments in the Middle East, evolving inflation expectations and shifting expectations for monetary policy. Treasury yields moved higher overall as concerns over fiscal deficits, increased Treasury supply, and persistent inflation risks. The Fed kept interest rates unchanged throughout the quarter but maintained a relatively hawkish stance, signalling a cautious approach towards policy easing. As a result, the Treasury yield curve bear flattened over the period, with the 10-year US Treasury yield increased from 4.32% to 4.47% over the quarter.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 中港股市在第二季表現顯著分歧，在岸A股表現優於離岸市場。上證綜合指數報升6.0%，受惠於境內流動性充裕，以及市場對人工智能相關硬件股（包括本土半導體生產商及晶片設計商）的熱潮持續。而恒生指數則跌6.4%，主要受5 月底推出的跨境資金流監管收緊措施，以及互聯網及消費股持續疲弱所拖累。市場宏觀環境仍然好淡紛呈：第一季國內生產總值擴張5.0%，出口在季初急升（5月按年升19.4%），但本土經濟活動在6 月大幅放緩，零售銷售按年跌0.6%，固定資產投資按年跌10.7%。通脹維持在1.2%的低水平，信貸增長亦轉弱。人行維持寬鬆立場，但未有採取大規模寬鬆措施，政策預期集中於年內稍後可能推出的支持措施。
managerCommentary.en: Chinese and Hong Kong equities diverged sharply in Q2, with onshore A-shares outperforming offshore markets. The Shanghai Composite returned 6.0%, benefiting from abundant domestic liquidity and sustained enthusiasm for AI-related hardware names — including domestic semiconductor producers and chip designers. The Hang Seng Index declined -6.4%, weighed by regulatory tightening on cross-border capital flows introduced in late May and persistent weakness in internet and consumer stocks. The macro backdrop remained mixed: Q1 GDP expanded 5.0%, exports surged early in the quarter (+19.4% yoy in May), but domestic activity softened materially by June, with retail sales declining -0.6% yoy and fixed-asset investment falling -10.7% yoy. Inflation remained subdued at 1.2%, and credit growth weakened. The PBOC maintained an accommodative stance but refrained from broad-based easing, leaving policy expectations focused on potential support later in the year.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: MSCI世界指數在第二季報升13.9%，升勢明顯集中於增長股及受惠於人工智能的市場。標準普爾500總回報指數報升15.2%，創2020年以來最強勁的季度升幅。升勢初期由受惠於人工智能的超大型股帶動，其後隨著季內發展，升勢擴展至周期股。全球資訊科技行業大幅領先，能源行業則因油價回落而表現落後。歐盟STOXX 50指數上升15.7%，資訊科技及金融行業表現領先。日本股市錄得尤其強勁的回報，日本TOPIX總回報指數上升14.3%，日經225指數亦升37.3%，主要受日圓疲弱及人工智能╱半導體走強所支持。新興市場表現顯著領先，MSCI新興市場指數上升24.1%，但升幅高度集中於北亞地區：南韓綜合股價指數急升67.9%，台灣加權指數則在半導體動力帶動下揚升46.0%。中國市場表現遜色，恒生指數下跌6.4%，主要受數據好淡紛呈及人工智能直接投資比重較低所影響。
managerCommentary.en: The MSCI World Index returned +13.9% in Q2, with leadership firmly concentrated in growth and AI-exposed markets. The S&P 500 Total Return Index returned +15.2%, posting its strongest quarterly gain since 2020, initially driven by mega-cap AI beneficiaries but broadening to cyclicals as the quarter progressed. Information technology led by a wide margin globally, while energy lagged as oil prices retreated. The EURO STOXX 50 Index rose +15.7%, with IT and financials leading. Japan delivered particularly strong returns — the TOPIX Total Return Index returned +14.3% and the Nikkei 225 Index rose +37.3% — supported by yen weakness and AI/semiconductor strength. Emerging markets sharply outperformed, with the MSCI Emerging Markets Index gaining +24.1%, though gains were highly concentrated in North Asia: Korea’s KOSPI Index surged +67.9% and Taiwan’s TWSE Index gained +46.0% on semiconductor momentum. China underperformed, with the Hang Seng Index declining -6.4% amid mixed data and less direct AI exposure.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 亞洲在第二季錄得卓越回報，由北亞半導體及人工智能動力帶動，惟區內表現高度集中。繼3月份資金流出後，受半導體盈利表現卓越、外資重新流入所支持，南韓綜合股價指數急升67.9%。然而，持續的外國拋售和與槓桿ETF部位相關的技術性錯位進一步加劇了市場波動。台灣加權指數揚升46.0%，受晶片製造商業績強勁，以及台積電將2026 年全年收益指引上調至超過30%所支持。印度 Nifty 50指數於季初表現落後，5月因資訊科技行業受人工智能取代憂慮影響而下跌，但隨著油價急挫改善能源進口環境，其後在6月有所回升。東協市場整體表現疲弱且波動，印尼雅加達綜合指數受印尼盾疲弱及央行收緊政策影響而大幅下跌（5月跌11.3%，6月跌7.0%），而新加坡及菲律賓則錄得輕微升幅。澳洲方面，標準普爾╱澳洲證交所200指數表現持平，因商品價格走軟，拖累能源及材料股。
managerCommentary.en: Asia delivered exceptional returns in Q2, driven by North Asian semiconductor and AI momentum, though regional performance was highly concentrated. South Korea’s KOSPI Index surged +67.9%, with a clear standout on exceptional semiconductor earnings, and renewed foreign inflows after March outflows. However, persistent foreign selling and technical dislocations linked to leveraged ETF positioning exacerbated volatility. Taiwan’s TWSE Index gained +46.0%, supported by strong chipmaker results and TSMC’s raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to over +30%. India’s Nifty 50 lagged early in the quarter, declining in May amid IT sector pressure from AI-driven obsolescence concerns, but recovered to in June as oil price collapse improved the energy import backdrop. Across ASEAN, performance was subdued and volatile, with Indonesia’s JCI Index declining sharply (-11.3% in May, -7.0% in June) on rupiah weakness and central bank tightening, while Singapore and the Philippines posted modest gains. Australia’s S&P ASX 200 remained flat, dragged by energy and materials as commodity prices softened.

managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，環球市場持續關注經濟增長韌性與持續通脹風險之間的平衡，尤其是在上一季度末能源價格急升所帶來的衝擊後。香港方面，短期利率於季度內維持相對穩定，並處於具吸引力的水平，儘管期間流動性偶有波動。在銀行體系流動性充裕的支持下，香港銀行同業拆息持續低於相若期限的美元融資成本，進一步提升港元貨幣市場工具的吸引力，並支持相關投資需求。此外，在聯繫匯率制度下，港元兌美元匯率維持大致穩定。
managerCommentary.en: During second quarter of 2026, global markets remained focused on the balance between resilient growth and persistent inflation risks following the energy-price shock that emerged at the end of the previous quarter. In Hong Kong, short-term interest rates remained relatively stable at attractive levels despite intermittent liquidity fluctuations. HIBOR continued to trade below comparable USD funding rates amid ample banking system liquidity, supporting demand for HKD money market instruments. The HKD remained broadly stable against the USD under the Linked Exchange Rate System.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 環球股票在2026年第二季報升，原因是投資者傾向看好由人工智能相關的半導體和數據基建供應鏈，以及美國與伊朗宣布停火框架，有助降低市場對局勢升級的憂慮，促使油價回落，並帶動風險偏好重估。領漲動力仍集中於增長股及受惠於人工智能的市場，亞洲及科技比重較高的地區普遍領先。固定收益市場整體錄得正回報，惟各國央行繼續收緊政策：歐洲央行及日本央行各自加息25個基點，而聯儲局在新任主席沃什（Kevin Warsh）領導下維持利率不變。信貸市場繼續獲得良好支持，隨著息差收窄，投資級別債券表現優於政府債券。新興市場資產表現顯著優於已發展市場，尤其是北亞股票及本幣債券。
managerCommentary.en: Global equities rose in Q2 2026, as investors leaned into the AI-driven capex cycle and the associated semiconductor and data-infrastructure supply chain. The announcement of a US–Iran ceasefire framework helped reduce escalation fears, contributing to a pullback in oil prices and a rerating of risk appetite. Leadership remained concentrated in growth and AI-exposed markets, with broad outperformance from Asia and technology-heavy regions. Fixed income markets delivered positive returns overall, though central banks continued to tighten: the ECB and Bank of Japan each raised rates by 25 bps, while the Federal Reserve held steady under new Chair Kevin Warsh. Credit markets remained well supported, with investment-grade and high-yield bonds outperforming government bonds as spreads tightened. Emerging market assets, particularly North Asian equities, and local-currency bonds, significantly outperformed developed markets.

managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，中國政府債券孳息率大致維持穩定，儘管通脹動態有所改善及出口表現保持韌性。政策制定者維持寬鬆的貨幣政策立場，同時強調透過定向措施支持經濟增長，而非推出大規模刺激政策。內需復甦步伐仍然不均衡，消費及投資活動僅逐步改善。與此同時，儘管消費物價指數及生產者價格出現溫和回升，整體通脹壓力仍然受到控制。中國人民銀行持續審慎管理市場流動性，為在岸及離岸人民幣市場提供有利的融資環境。
managerCommentary.en: During second quarter of 2026, Chinese government bond yields remained broadly stable despite improving inflation dynamics and resilient export performance. Policymakers maintained an accommodative monetary stance while emphasizing targeted support for growth rather than broad-based stimulus. Domestic demand remained uneven, with consumption and investment activity recovering only gradually, while inflation pressures remained under control despite a modest rebound in CPI and producer prices. The PBoC continued to manage liquidity conditions prudently, supporting favorable funding conditions across onshore and offshore RMB markets.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 環球股市於季內錄得強勁升幅，富時強積金環球指數於季內錄得超過15%升幅，主要受惠於地緣政治緊張局勢緩和、油價回落及市場對人工智能相關投資持續樂觀。股市於4月顯著反彈，並於5月在美伊協議憧憬及油價下跌支持下進一步上升。6月市場表現則出現分化，歐洲及英國股市持續向好，而美國股市於前期強勁升勢後略為回調。科技板塊繼續受人工智能及半導體需求帶動，成為市場主要升市動力；相反，能源板塊於季末因油價回落而表現相對落後。
managerCommentary.en: Global equity markets delivered strong gains over the quarter, FTSE MPF All World Index returned over 15%, supported by easing geopolitical tensions, falling oil prices and continued enthusiasm around AI-related investment. Equity markets rebounded strongly in April following the volatility of the previous month, while further gains in May were supported by hopes of a potential US–Iran agreement and a sharp decline in oil prices. Performance was more mixed in June, with European and UK equities advancing while US markets pulled back after a period of strong performance. Technology-related sectors remained a key driver throughout the quarter, reflecting continued demand linked to AI and semiconductors, while energy lagged later in the period as oil prices moved materially lower.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，市場情緒維持波動，美伊衝突持續升溫加劇市場對全球能源供應受阻的憂慮。能源供應短缺風險、能源價格上升，以及地緣政治局勢進一步惡化的可能性，均不時推動市場風險規避情緒升溫，並加深投資者對通脹前景、經濟增長及貨幣政策走向的不確定性。然而，隨著美國與伊朗宣布達成初步停火協議，市場情緒於季度後期明顯改善。在此背景下，富時強積金環球政府債券指數表現相對穩健，季內錄得0.6%升幅。
managerCommentary.en: Market sentiment remained volatile in 2Q2026 as geopolitical tensions surrounding the US-Iran conflict heightened concerns over global energy supply disruptions. Concerns over supply shortages, higher energy prices and the potential for a broader escalation in geopolitical tensions drove periodic increases in risk aversion across asset markets. These developments added to existing uncertainty surrounding inflation, economic growth and the future path of monetary policy. Sentiment improved meaningfully towards the end of the quarter following the announcement of a preliminary ceasefire agreement between the United States and Iran. Against this backdrop, the FTSE MPF World Government Bond Index, remained relatively resilient with return of 0.6% over the quarter.

managerCommentary.en: During second quarter of 2026, global markets remained focused on the balance between resilient growth and persistent inflation risks following the energy-price shock that emerged at the end of the previous quarter. In Hong Kong, short-term interest rates remained relatively stable at attractive levels despite intermittent liquidity fluctuations. HIBOR continued to trade below comparable USD funding rates amid ample banking system liquidity, supporting demand for HKD money market instruments. The HKD remained broadly stable against the USD under the Linked Exchange Rate System.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 政府債券市場在第二季整體造好，但表現仍然波動，收益率跟隨能源價格波動。表現方面，彭博美國國庫券總回報指數上升0.3%，表現遜於歐元區國庫券（升1.9%）及英國金邊債券（升2.1%）。新興市場債券表現出色，彭博新興市場本幣債券指數上升2.80%。儘管經濟增長風險依然存在，但各國央行越來越不願意「忽視」通脹衝擊。聯儲局維持利率於3.50%至 3.75%，沃什於6月接任領導層，有助鞏固市場對政策將保持緊縮但不會機械式收緊的預期。歐洲央行在6月加息25 個基點至2.25%，理由是通脹高於目標及能源帶動價格壓力，同時亦上調通脹預測並下調增長預測。英倫銀行維持利率於3.75% 不變，金邊債券受國內政治發展影響，包括首相施紀賢辭職。日本央行加息25個基點至1.00%，抵制日圓持續貶值。
managerCommentary.en: Government bond markets were positive overall but remained volatile in Q2, with yields tracking energy price swings. In terms of performance, the Bloomberg US Treasury Total Return Index added +0.3%, underperforming both euro treasuries (+1.9%) and UK gilts (+2.1%). Emerging market bonds outperformed, with the Bloomberg EM Local Currency Index returning +2.80%. Central banks were becoming less willing to “look through” inflation shocks despite lingering growth risks. The Federal Reserve held rates at 3.50%-3.75%, with Kevin Warsh’s leadership transition in June anchoring expectations of a restrictive but non-mechanical policy stance. The European Central Bank raised rates by 25 bps to 2.25% in June, citing above-target inflation and energy-driven price pressures, while also revising inflation forecasts higher and trimming growth projections. The Bank of England held rates unchanged at 3.75%, with gilts influenced by domestic political developments including PM Keir Starmer’s resignation. The Bank of Japan raised rates by 25 bps to 1.00%, to resist the continued depreciation of the yen.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 環球股票在2026 年第二季報升，原因是投資者傾向看好由人工智能相關的半導體和數據基建供應鏈，以及美國與伊朗宣布停火框架，有助降低市場對局勢升級的憂慮，促使油價回落，並帶動風險偏好重估。領漲動力仍集中於增長股及受惠於人工智能的市場，亞洲及科技比重較高的地區普遍領先。固定收益市場整體錄得正回報，惟各國央行繼續收緊政策：歐洲央行及日本央行各自加息25 個基點，而聯儲局在新任主席沃什（Kevin Warsh）領導下維持利率不變。信貸市場繼續獲得良好支持，隨著息差收窄，投資級別債券表現優於政府債券。新興市場資產表現顯著優於已發展市場，尤其是北亞股票及本幣債券。
managerCommentary.en: Global equities rose in Q2 2026, as investors leaned into the AI-driven capex cycle and the associated semiconductor and data-infrastructure supply chain. The announcement of a US–Iran ceasefire framework helped reduce escalation fears, contributing to a pullback in oil prices and a rerating of risk appetite. Leadership remained concentrated in growth and AI-exposed markets, with broad outperformance from Asia and technology-heavy regions. Fixed income markets delivered positive returns overall, though central banks continued to tighten: the ECB and Bank of Japan each raised rates by 25 bps, while the Federal Reserve held steady under new Chair Kevin Warsh. Credit markets remained well supported, with investment-grade and high-yield bonds outperforming government bonds as spreads tightened. Emerging market assets, particularly North Asian equities, and local-currency bonds, significantly outperformed developed markets.
