managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 亞洲在第二季錄得卓越回報，由北亞半導體及人工智能動力帶動，惟區內表現高度集中。繼3月份資金流出後，受半導體盈利表現卓越、外資重新流入所支持，南韓綜合股價指數急升67.9%。然而，持續的外國拋售和與槓桿ETF部位相關的技術性錯位進一步加劇了市場波動。台灣加權指數揚升46.0%，受晶片製造商業績強勁，以及台積電將2026 年全年收益指引上調至超過30%所支持。印度 Nifty 50指數於季初表現落後，5月因資訊科技行業受人工智能取代憂慮影響而下跌，但隨著油價急挫改善能源進口環境，其後在6月有所回升。東協市場整體表現疲弱且波動，印尼雅加達綜合指數受印尼盾疲弱及央行收緊政策影響而大幅下跌（5月跌11.3%，6月跌7.0%），而新加坡及菲律賓則錄得輕微升幅。澳洲方面，標準普爾╱澳洲證交所200指數表現持平，因商品價格走軟，拖累能源及材料股。
managerCommentary.en: Asia delivered exceptional returns in Q2, driven by North Asian semiconductor and AI momentum, though regional performance was highly concentrated. South Korea’s KOSPI Index surged +67.9%, with a clear standout on exceptional semiconductor earnings, and renewed foreign inflows after March outflows. However, persistent foreign selling and technical dislocations linked to leveraged ETF positioning exacerbated volatility. Taiwan’s TWSE Index gained +46.0%, supported by strong chipmaker results and TSMC’s raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to over +30%. India’s Nifty 50 lagged early in the quarter, declining in May amid IT sector pressure from AI-driven obsolescence concerns, but recovered to in June as oil price collapse improved the energy import backdrop. Across ASEAN, performance was subdued and volatile, with Indonesia’s JCI Index declining sharply (-11.3% in May, -7.0% in June) on rupiah weakness and central bank tightening, while Singapore and the Philippines posted modest gains. Australia’s S&P ASX 200 remained flat, dragged by energy and materials as commodity prices softened.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 環球股票在2026 年第二季報升，原因是投資者傾向看好由人工智能相關的半導體和數據基建供應鏈，以及美國與伊朗宣布停火框架，有助降低市場對局勢升級的憂慮，促使油價回落，並帶動風險偏好重估。領漲動力仍集中於增長股及受惠於人工智能的市場，亞洲及科技比重較高的地區普遍領先。固定收益市場整體錄得正回報，惟各國央行繼續收緊政策：歐洲央行及日本央行各自加息25 個基點，而聯儲局在新任主席沃什（Kevin Warsh）領導下維持利率不變。信貸市場繼續獲得良好支持，隨著息差收窄，投資級別債券表現優於政府債券。新興市場資產表現顯著優於已發展市場，尤其是北亞股票及本幣債券。
managerCommentary.en: Global equities rose in Q2 2026, as investors leaned into the AI-driven capex cycle and the associated semiconductor and data-infrastructure supply chain. The announcement of a US–Iran ceasefire framework helped reduce escalation fears, contributing to a pullback in oil prices and a rerating of risk appetite. Leadership remained concentrated in growth and AI-exposed markets, with broad outperformance from Asia and technology-heavy regions. Fixed income markets delivered positive returns overall, though central banks continued to tighten: the ECB and Bank of Japan each raised rates by 25 bps, while the Federal Reserve held steady under new Chair Kevin Warsh. Credit markets remained well supported, with investment-grade and high-yield bonds outperforming government bonds as spreads tightened. Emerging market assets, particularly North Asian equities, and local-currency bonds, significantly outperformed developed markets.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: MSCI綜合世界指數第二季大幅上升14.5%，但市場走勢深受中東局勢發展的影響。整體而言，股市與油價走勢相反。但在季內後期，脆弱的和平協議似乎有望維持，隨著取道霍爾木茲海峽的全球石油運輸恢復，有助提振市場情緒。SpaceX在納斯達克首次公開上市，進一步增強市場承險意欲，但對人工智能估值偏高及支出的擔憂不時重現。隨著投資者應對中東地緣政治局勢發展，以及通脹預期和貨幣政策預期出現轉變，第二季美國國債波動加劇。市場關注財政赤字、國債供應增加及持續通脹風險，令整體國債收益率上揚。聯儲局在季內維持利率不變，但維持相對鷹派的立場，暗示對放寬政策持審慎態度。因此，美國國債收益率曲線在期內出現「熊市趨平」，10年期美國國債收益率在季內從4.32%上升至4.47%。
managerCommentary.en: The MSCI All Country World Index (ACWI) rose sharply for 14.5% in Q2, but market movements were heavily influenced by developments in the Middle East. However, sentiment was bolstered later in the period as a fragile peace deal looked to be holding, also the resumption of global oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz. The SpaceX IPO further reinforced the risk-on mood, although renewed fears about lofty AI valuations and spending flared intermittently. US Treasury experienced heightened volatility in Q2, as investors navigated geopolitical developments in the Middle East, evolving inflation expectations and shifting expectations for monetary policy. Treasury yields moved higher overall as concerns over fiscal deficits, increased Treasury supply, and persistent inflation risks. The Fed kept interest rates unchanged throughout the quarter but maintained a relatively hawkish stance, signalling a cautious approach towards policy easing. As a result, the Treasury yield curve bear flattened over the period, with the 10-year US Treasury yield increased from 4.32% to 4.47% over the quarter.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: MSCI世界指數在第二季報升 13.9%，升勢明顯集中於增長股及受惠於人工智能的市場。標準普爾500總回報指數報升15.2%，創2020年以來最強勁的季度升幅。升勢初期由受惠於人工智能的超大型股帶動，其後隨著季內發展，升勢擴展至周期股。全球資訊科技行業大幅領先，能源行業則因油價回落而表現落後。歐盟STOXX 50指數上升15.7%，資訊科技及金融行業表現領先。日本股市錄得尤其強勁的回報，日本TOPIX總回報指數上升14.3%，日經 225指數亦升37.3%，主要受日圓疲弱及人工智能╱半導體走強所支持。新興市場表現顯著領先，MSCI新興市場指數上升24.1%，但升幅高度集中於北亞地區：南韓綜合股價指數急升67.9%，台灣加權指數則在半導體動力帶動下揚升46.0%。中國市場表現遜色，恒生指數下跌6.4%，主要受數據好淡紛呈及人工智能直接投資比重較低所影響。
managerCommentary.en: The MSCI World Index returned +13.9% in Q2, with leadership firmly concentrated in growth and AI-exposed markets. The S&P 500 Total Return Index returned +15.2%, posting its strongest quarterly gain since 2020, initially driven by mega-cap AI beneficiaries but broadening to cyclicals as the quarter progressed. Information technology led by a wide margin globally, while energy lagged as oil prices retreated. The EURO STOXX 50 Index rose +15.7%, with IT and financials leading. Japan delivered particularly strong returns — the TOPIX Total Return Index returned +14.3% and the Nikkei 225 Index rose +37.3% — supported by yen weakness and AI/semiconductor strength. Emerging markets sharply outperformed, with the MSCI Emerging Markets Index gaining +24.1%, though gains were highly concentrated in North Asia: Korea’s KOSPI Index surged +67.9% and Taiwan’s TWSE Index gained +46.0% on semiconductor momentum. China underperformed, with the Hang Seng Index declining -6.4% amid mixed data and less direct AI exposure.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 中港股市在第二季表現顯著分歧，在岸A 股表現優於離岸市場。上證綜合指數報升6.0%，受惠於境內流動性充裕，以及市場對人工智能相關硬件股（包括本土半導體生產商及晶片設計商）的熱潮持續。而恒生指數則跌6.4%，主要受 5月底推出的跨境資金流監管收緊措施，以及互聯網及消費股持續疲弱所拖累。市場宏觀環境仍然好淡紛呈：第一季國內生產總值擴張5.0%，出口在季初急升（5月按年升19.4%），但本土經濟活動在6月大幅放緩，零售銷售按年跌0.6%，固定資產投資按年跌10.7%。通脹維持在1.2%的低水平，信貸增長亦轉弱。人行維持寬鬆立場，但未有採取大規模寬鬆措施，政策預期集中於年內稍後可能推出的支持措施。
managerCommentary.en: Chinese and Hong Kong equities diverged sharply in Q2, with onshore A-shares outperforming offshore markets. The Shanghai Composite returned 6.0%, benefiting from abundant domestic liquidity and sustained enthusiasm for AI-related hardware names — including domestic semiconductor producers and chip designers. The Hang Seng Index declined -6.4%, weighed by regulatory tightening on cross-border capital flows introduced in late May and persistent weakness in internet and consumer stocks. The macro backdrop remained mixed: Q1 GDP expanded 5.0%, exports surged early in the quarter (+19.4% yoy in May), but domestic activity softened materially by June, with retail sales declining -0.6% yoy and fixed-asset investment falling -10.7% yoy. Inflation remained subdued at 1.2%, and credit growth weakened. The PBOC maintained an accommodative stance but refrained from broad-based easing, leaving policy expectations focused on potential support later in the year.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 歐盟STOXX 50指數在第二季上升15.7%，但因能源衝擊令投資氣氛受壓，增長動力減弱，導致歐元區第一季國內生產總值按季收縮0.2%，為自2022年第四季以來首次收縮；而整體消費物價指數在5月加速至 3.2%，創2023 年9月以來最高水平。國家之間的分歧明顯，德國及意大利初段表現領先，而法國和英國則受政治雜音及通脹居高不下影響而表現落後。6月份出現顯著逆轉，油價急挫及地緣政治緊張局勢緩和，帶動市場反彈4.7%，其中西班牙（升6.0%）及意大利（升3.4%）領漲。能源股重新定價及通脹放緩（消費物價指數回落至 2.8%），支持市場輪換，轉向周期股和價值股。歐洲央行在6月加息25個基點至2.25%，市場視之為審慎正常化而非激進收緊政策，加上通脹壓力開始消退，有助股市消化加息的影響。
managerCommentary.en: The EURO STOXX 50 Index rose +15.7% in Q2, though the energy shock weighed on sentiment and growth momentum faltered — Eurozone GDP contracted -0.2% q/q in Q1, the first decline since Q4 2022, while headline CPI accelerated to 3.2% by May, the highest since September 2023. Country dispersion was pronounced, with Germany and Italy outperforming early on, while France and the UK lagged amid political noise and sticky inflation. June brought a sharp reversal as oil prices collapsed and geopolitical tensions eased, driving a +4.7% rally led by Spain (+6.0%) and Italy (+3.4%). The energy repricing and moderating inflation — CPI easing to 2.8% — supported a rotation into cyclicals and value. The ECB raised rates by 25bp to 2.25% in June, viewed as cautious normalization rather than aggressive tightening, helping equities absorb the move as inflation pressures began to recede.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 在第二季度，地緣政治與科技因素仍然主導市場走勢。隨著中東戰事開始降溫，風險情緒轉為明顯正面。由於市場評估能源價格波動對通脹與增長的影響，全球債券市場在第二季度未呈現明確方向。目前，幾乎沒有證據顯示較高通脹正傳導至更高工資。儘管勞動市場相對緊俏，失業率為4.3%，私人就業增長亦保持健康，但5月份所有工人的平均時薪僅上升3.5%，為過去五年中第二低的增幅。因此，聯儲局維持利率於3.50%-3.75%不變並不令人意外，但其聲明與新聞發布會的措辭則偏鷹派。在利率方面，10年期美國國債收益率於第二季末收於4.47%（3月底為4.31%）；10 年期德國國債收益率收於2.91%（此前為3.00%）；10年期英國國債收益率收於4.77%（此前為4.88%）。
managerCommentary.en: In Q2, geopolitics and technology continued to dominate market movements. Risk sentiment turned decisively positive as the war in the Middle East began to de-escalate. Global bond markets didn’t have a clear direction in the Q2 as markets evaluated the impact of energy price volatility on inflation and growth. Currently, there is little evidence that higher inflation is feeding through to higher wages. Despite a relatively tight labour market with an unemployment rate of 4.3% and healthy private payroll growth, average hourly earnings for all workers rose just 3.5% in May, the second-smallest gain in five years. Not surprisingly, the Fed held interest rates at 3.50%-3.75%, but both the statement and press conference skewed hawkish. In rates, ten-year U.S. Treasuries ended Q2 at 4.47% (up from 4.31% at March-end), ten-year Bunds at 2.91% (3.00% prior), and ten-year Gilts at 4.77% (4.88% prior).

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 香港首次公開招股市場於2026 年上半年仍是全球表現最強勁的市場之一。截至6月底，集資額超過2,000億港元，創五年來最佳上半年表現。但反映中港股票表現的恒生指數在季內跌7.7%。指數在3月份向好，但其後在 5月份和 6月份表現疲弱。行業方面，消費、能源及公用事業在季內錄得最大跌幅。投資環境也受到中央政府加強資本管制的影響，該管制措施透過實施國務院第837號令（關於境外投資的規定），該規定將於2026年 7月1日生效。這項監管轉變將境外投資提升為行政法律，限制企業和個人跨國流動，以維護國家安全和數據主權。
managerCommentary.en: Hong Kong’s IPO market remained one of the strongest globally in the first half of 2026. By the end of June, funds raised exceeded HK$200 billion, the strongest first-half performance in five years. But HK & China equities, measured by Hang Seng Index, declined 7.7% over the quarter. Index was positive in March but then detracted in May and June. In sector perspective, consumers, energy and utilities, declined the most during the quarter. Investment sentiment also weighed on by the central government escalated its capital controls by implementing State Council Decree No. 837 (Provisions on Outbound Investment), which would take effect on July 1, 2026. This regulatory shift elevates outbound investment to an administrative law and restricts both corporate and individual cross-border flows to safeguard national security and data sovereignty.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: MSCI世界指數在第二季報升13.9%，升勢明顯集中於增長股及受惠於人工智能的市場。標準普爾500總回報指數報升15.2%，創2020年以來最強勁的季度升幅。升勢初期由受惠於人工智能的超大型股帶動，其後隨著季內發展，升勢擴展至周期股。全球資訊科技行業大幅領先，能源行業則因油價回落而表現落後。歐盟STOXX 50指數上升15.7%，資訊科技及金融行業表現領先。日本股市錄得尤其強勁的回報，日本TOPIX總回報指數上升14.3%，日經225 指數亦升37.3%，主要受日圓疲弱及人工智能╱半導體走強所支持。新興市場表現顯著領先，MSCI新興市場指數上升24.1%，但升幅高度集中於北亞地區：南韓綜合股價指數急升67.9%，台灣加權指數則在半導體動力帶動下揚升46.0%。中國市場表現遜色，恒生指數下跌6.4%，主要受數據好淡紛呈及人工智能直接投資比重較低所影響。
managerCommentary.en: The MSCI World Index returned +13.9% in Q2, with leadership firmly concentrated in growth and AI-exposed markets. The S&P 500 Total Return Index returned +15.2%, posting its strongest quarterly gain since 2020, initially driven by mega-cap AI beneficiaries but broadening to cyclicals as the quarter progressed. Information technology led by a wide margin globally, while energy lagged as oil prices retreated. The EURO STOXX 50 Index rose +15.7%, with IT and financials leading. Japan delivered particularly strong returns — the TOPIX Total Return Index returned +14.3% and the Nikkei 225 Index rose +37.3% — supported by yen weakness and AI/semiconductor strength. Emerging markets sharply outperformed, with the MSCI Emerging Markets Index gaining +24.1%, though gains were highly concentrated in North Asia: Korea’s KOSPI Index surged +67.9% and Taiwan’s TWSE Index gained +46.0% on semiconductor momentum. China underperformed, with the Hang Seng Index declining -6.4% amid mixed data and less direct AI exposure.

managerCommentary.zh: 第二季，富時強積金大中華指數錄得+14.7%，科技業（+43.6%）及工業（12.4%）表現領先，而非必選消費（-15.5%）及能源（-14.7%）相對落後。大中華權益被兩條宏大敘事主導。其一是AI硬體超級週期：HBM擠壓下存儲全面缺貨、漲價貫穿全年，台積電先進制程接連提價、緊缺料延續至2027年，為全市場最強主線。其二是海外流動性再收緊：美聯儲由等待寬鬆轉向討論加息，美債利率與美元走強，壓制高估值成長與離岸資產。結果A股科技獨立走強、台股受AI景氣支撐，港股則因外資持續流出與強美元而全球墊底。
managerCommentary.en: In Q2, the FTSE MPF Greater China Index gained 14.7%, led by Technology (+43.6%) and Industrials (+12.4%), while Consumer Discretionary (-15.5%) and Energy (-14.7%) lagged. Greater China equities were driven by two dominant themes. First, the AI hardware super cycle: HBM shortages tightened memory supply and supported price increases throughout the year, while TSMC repeatedly raised prices for advanced-node capacity, with supply constraints expected to persist through 2027, making AI the market’s strongest growth driver. Second, tighter global liquidity: the Federal Reserve shifted from awaiting easing to discussing further rate hikes, pushing Treasury yields and the U.S. dollar higher. As a result, A-share technology stocks outperformed, Taiwan equities benefited from the AI boom, while Hong Kong stocks ranked among the world’s weakest markets due to persistent foreign outflows and dollar strength.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，中國政府債券孳息率大致維持穩定，儘管通脹動態有所改善及出口表現保持韌性。政策制定者維持寬鬆的貨幣政策立場，同時強調透過定向措施支持經濟增長，而非推出大規模刺激政策。內需復甦步伐仍然不均衡，消費及投資活動僅逐步改善。與此同時，儘管消費物價指數及生產者價格出現溫和回升，整體通脹壓力仍然受到控制。中國人民銀行持續審慎管理市場流動性，為在岸及離岸人民幣市場提供有利的融資環境。
managerCommentary.en: During second quarter of 2026, Chinese government bond yields remained broadly stable despite improving inflation dynamics and resilient export performance. Policymakers maintained an accommodative monetary stance while emphasizing targeted support for growth rather than broad-based stimulus. Domestic demand remained uneven, with consumption and investment activity recovering only gradually, while inflation pressures remained under control despite a modest rebound in CPI and producer prices. The PBoC continued to manage liquidity conditions prudently, supporting favorable funding conditions across onshore and offshore RMB markets.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 環球股市於季內錄得強勁升幅，富時強積金環球指數於季內錄得超過15%升幅，主要受惠於地緣政治緊張局勢緩和、油價回落及市場對人工智能相關投資持續樂觀。股市於4月顯著反彈，並於5月在美伊協議憧憬及油價下跌支持下進一步上升。6月市場表現則出現分化，歐洲及英國股市持續向好，而美國股市於前期強勁升勢後略為回調。科技板塊繼續受人工智能及半導體需求帶動，成為市場主要升市動力；相反，能源板塊於季末因油價回落而表現相對落後。
managerCommentary.en: Global equity markets delivered strong gains over the quarter, FTSE MPF All World Index returned over 15%, supported by easing geopolitical tensions, falling oil prices and continued enthusiasm around AI-related investment. Equity markets rebounded strongly in April following the volatility of the previous month, while further gains in May were supported by hopes of a potential US–Iran agreement and a sharp decline in oil prices. Performance was more mixed in June, with European and UK equities advancing while US markets pulled back after a period of strong performance. Technology-related sectors remained a key driver throughout the quarter, reflecting continued demand linked to AI and semiconductors, while energy lagged later in the period as oil prices moved materially lower.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，市場情緒維持波動，美伊衝突持續升溫加劇市場對全球能源供應受阻的憂慮。能源供應短缺風險、能源價格上升，以及地緣政治局勢進一步惡化的可能性，均不時推動市場風險規避情緒升溫，並加深投資者對通脹前景、經濟增長及貨幣政策走向的不確定性。然而，隨著美國與伊朗宣布達成初步停火協議，市場情緒於季度後期明顯改善。在此背景下，富時強積金環球政府債券指數表現相對穩健，季內錄得0.6%升幅。
managerCommentary.en: Market sentiment remained volatile in 2Q2026 as geopolitical tensions surrounding the US-Iran conflict heightened concerns over global energy supply disruptions. Concerns over supply shortages, higher energy prices and the potential for a broader escalation in geopolitical tensions drove periodic increases in risk aversion across asset markets. These developments added to existing uncertainty surrounding inflation, economic growth and the future path of monetary policy. Sentiment improved meaningfully towards the end of the quarter following the announcement of a preliminary ceasefire agreement between the United States and Iran. Against this backdrop, the FTSE MPF World Government Bond Index, remained relatively resilient with return of 0.6% over the quarter.

managerCommentary.zh: 美伊緊張局勢緩和，企業盈利穩健，加上人工智能樂觀情緒持續，為投資氣氛帶來支持，帶動環球股市在第二季揚升。油價早前上升，引發通脹憂慮，其後有所回落，因為中東停火談判緩和供應中斷的憂慮。美國聯儲局維持利率不變，但表示如果通脹壓力持續，可能會進一步收緊政策。地區方面，人工智能推動半導體需求，使新興市場大幅走高，美國及日本亦穩健報升。行業方面，儘管季末資訊科技業因獲利套現及估值憂慮而回落，但仍錄得最大升幅。隨著投資者對油價變動、地緣政治風險及央行預期轉變作出應對，環球固定收益市場在第二季表現向好，但走勢波動。
managerCommentary.en: Global equities advanced in the second quarter as easing US-Iran tensions, resilient corporate earnings and continued AI optimism supported investor sentiment. Following an earlier uptick raising inflation concerns, oil prices moderated as ceasefire talks in the Middle East reduced fears of supply disruptions. The US Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged but signalled that further policy tightening is possible if inflationary pressures persist. Regionally, emerging markets advanced strongly on AI-driven semiconductor demand, while US and Japan also posted solid gains. At a sectoral level, IT led the gains despite a late-quarter pullback amid profit-taking and valuation concerns. Global fixed-income markets delivered positive performance in the second quarter, although performance was volatile as investors responded to shifting oil prices, geopolitical risks and evolving central bank expectations.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 標準普爾500總回報指數在第二季報升15.2%，創2020 年以來最強勁的季度升幅。4月及5月錄得異常升幅（分別為+10.5%及+5.3%），原因是投資者對科技及金融行業強勁的第一季盈利反應正面。納斯達克指數表現出色，單在4月已上升15.7%。然而，6月份出現顯著逆轉，新任主席沃什釋出鷹派訊號，推高短期債券收益率及美元走強，引發資金從擁擠的超大型科技股撤出。道瓊斯工業平均指數在6月上升2.7%，反映市場轉向價值股和本土市場主導的周期股。季內，勞工市場數據強韌及消費穩定為股市帶來支持，但通脹持續（整體消費物價指數在5月加快至4.2%），令聯儲局維持利率不變，並加強利率長期偏高的前景，限制美股季末升幅。
managerCommentary.en: The S&P 500 Total Return Index returned +15.2% in Q2, posting its strongest quarterly gain since 2020. April and May saw exceptional gains (+10.5% and +5.3% respectively) as investors embraced the strong Q1 earnings from technology and financial sectors. The Nasdaq outperformed, gaining +15.7% in April alone. However, June brought a sharp rotation as the newly appointed Chair Warsh signalled a hawkish stance, pushing short-term yields and the US dollar higher and triggering a retreat from crowded mega-cap technology exposure. The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained +2.7% in June, reflecting the shift toward value and domestically oriented cyclicals. Throughout the quarter, resilient labour market data and steady consumption supported equities, though persistent inflation — headline CPI accelerating to 4.2% by May — kept the Fed on hold and reinforced a higher-for-longer rate outlook, ultimately capping gains of the US equities at end of the quarter.

managerCommentary.heading: Market Commentary 市場評論
managerCommentary.zh: 第二季伊朗戰爭引發的通脹影響主導市場，但實際衝擊小於預期。能源成本推高通脹，但與新冠疫情後不同，本次僅為供給衝擊而非需求衝擊－通脹料為暫時性。美國整體通脹加速，但核心通脹有所回落。經濟增長保持穩健，就業在低招聘、低裁員的環境下逐步恢復。中國方面，生產者價格受能源衝擊加速上行，但消費者價格保持平穩。本季度投資組合錄得正回報。在固定收益方面，儘管美國國債收益率上升拉低了債券價格，票息收入仍是債券持倉的主要回報來源，短存續期部署亦為相對收益帶來正面貢獻。在股票方面，港股工業及資訊科技板塊的選股仍為整體回報帶來貢獻，尤其是人工智慧及科技相關個股。
managerCommentary.en: In Q2, the inflationary fallout from the Iran war dominated markets, yet proved less disruptive than feared. Energy costs pushed inflation higher, but unlike the post Covid era, this is a supply shock without a demand shock inflation is likely temporary. US headline inflation accelerated, though core inflation eased. Growth remained robust, with jobs recovering amid low hiring and firing. In China, producer prices accelerated on the energy shock, but consumer prices held steady. Portfolio returns were positive over the quarter. In Fixed Income sleeve, despite higher US Treasury yields weighing on bond prices, coupon income remained the primary driver of bond performance, with short duration positioning contributing positively to relative returns. In equities sleeve, stock selection in Industrials and Information Technology, particularly AI and technology related names in Hong Kong equities, contributed to overall returns.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，亞太區（日本除外）股票表現異常強勁，富時強積金亞太區（日本除外）指數以港元計上升22.9%，主要受惠於科技板塊持續強勢，以及市場對人工智能投資週期的樂觀情緒。4月及5月市場大幅反彈，中東地緣政治局勢緩和、半導體及人工智能供應鏈企業第一季盈利強勁，加上美國超大型雲端營運商加大資本開支承諾，均提振了投資者信心，尤以南韓及台灣地區市場表現突出。雖然美國國債孳息率上升及通脹憂慮引發間歇性波動，但科技板塊的盈利上調持續為市場動能提供支撐。6月，市場因憂慮人工智能開支的可持續性、美元走強及美國聯儲局立場轉趨鷹派，而出現部分獲利回吐及整固。與此同時，中國內地及香港期內表現落後，因中國內地經濟數據仍然疲弱。此外，跨境資金管制的加強亦打擊了市場情緒。商品市場表現波動，布蘭特原油在4月因美伊緊張局勢而飆升至每桶110美元以上，其後隨霍爾木茲海峽重開及地緣政治風險緩和，於季末回落至約每桶73美元。板塊方面，資訊科技股在人工智能及數據中心需求持續支持下，成為全季表現最突出的行業；工業及金融板塊亦跑贏大市；而通訊服務及非必需消費品板塊則表現落後。
managerCommentary.en: Asia Pacific ex-Japan equities delivered an exceptionally strong performance in Q2 ‘26, with the FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex-Japan Index rising 22.9% in HKD terms, driven primarily by the continued strength of the technology sector and optimism surrounding the AI investment cycle. Markets rallied sharply in April and May as easing Middle East geopolitical tensions, strong first-quarter earnings from semiconductor and AI supply chain companies, and increased capital expenditure commitments from U.S. hyperscalers boosted investor confidence, particularly in Korea and Taiwan. While rising U.S. Treasury yields and inflation concerns caused periodic volatility, earnings upgrades across the technology sector continued to support market momentum. In June, markets consolidated some of their gains amid concerns over the sustainability of AI spending, a stronger U.S. dollar, and a more hawkish U.S. Federal Reserve stance. Meanwhile, China and Hong Kong underperformed during the quarter as China domestic economic data remained weak. Moreover, the step up in cross-border-capital controls also weighs on market sentiment. Commodity markets were volatile, with Brent crude oil surging above US$110/bbl in April amid U.S.-Iran tensions before retreating to approximately US$73/bbl by quarter-end following the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and easing geopolitical risks. Sector-wise, Information Technology was the standout performer throughout the quarter, supported by persistent AI and data-centre demand, while Industrials and Financials also outperformed, whereas Communication Services and Consumer Discretionary lagged the broader market.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 第二季度的主調，是市場由極度擔憂地緣政治，轉為更審慎評估地緣政治、通脹及結構性力量對環球經濟的長遠影響。股票市場在季初延續了3月底大幅拋售後的反彈走勢，因為投資者對中東衝突的看法日趨樂觀，認為其雖然嚴重，但不太可能對企業盈利造成廣泛的根本性損害，或引發全球經濟衰退。季內，市場焦點逐步從地緣政治事件本身，轉移至能源市場、通脹、貨幣政策與人工智能影響力加速之間的交互作用。本季度的突出特點之一，是在地緣政治風險升溫、通脹壓力持續及利率高企的背景下，環球市場仍展現出非凡韌性。投資者日益將焦點由中東衝突的直接影響，轉向能源安全、貨幣政策及人工智能的長遠影響。儘管經濟基本面依然穩健，但由於環球驅動因素對各地區及資產類別的影響日益加深，實現投資組合多元化亦變得更為困難。在此環境下，盈利持續性、定價能力、資產負債表實力，以及對差異化結構性增長驅動因素的敞口，仍是在日益互聯的環球格局中部署投資的關鍵考量。
managerCommentary.en: The second quarter was defined by a gradual transition from acute geopolitical fear toward a more measured assessment of how persistent geopolitical, inflationary, and structural forces will shape the global economy. Equity markets entered the quarter recovering from the sharp selloff experienced at the end of March as investors grew more confident that the Middle East conflict, while significant, was unlikely to cause widespread fundamental damage to corporate earnings or trigger a global recession. As the quarter progressed, market leadership increasingly shifted away from geopolitical headlines alone and toward the interaction between energy markets, inflation, monetary policy, and the accelerating influence of artificial intelligence. The quarter demonstrated that global markets remain remarkably resilient despite elevated geopolitical risks, persistent inflation pressures, and higher interest rates. Investors increasingly shifted their focus away from the immediate consequences of the Middle East conflict and toward the longer-term implications of energy security, monetary policy, and artificial intelligence. While economic fundamentals remain constructive, diversification has become more difficult to achieve as global drivers increasingly shape outcomes across regions and asset classes. In this environment, earnings durability, pricing power, balance sheet strength, and exposure to differentiated structural growth drivers remain critical factors for navigating an increasingly interconnected global landscape.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 第二季度地緣政治風險降溫，油價從3月及4月高位大幅回落約50美元，重返3月前水平。債券孳息率隨之回穩，風險資產在科技板塊帶領下重拾升勢。特朗普總統訪華亦反映中美關係有所改善，但雙方在科技主導地位及地緣影響力方面的角力仍然持續。貨幣政策在季度後半段主導市場焦點，聯儲局新任主席凱文 • 沃什（Kevin Warsh）多次強調必須達致2%的通脹目標，市場普遍視之為鷹派訊號。環球固定收益市場大致收復了第一季度的跌幅。本季度可分為上下兩個半段：4月錄得大部分升幅，而接近6月時市場對聯儲局鷹派立場的憂慮引發了顯著回吐。儘管市場憂慮聯儲局鷹派立場，但風險市場保持暢旺，帶動企業信貸息差仍見收窄。整體而言，美元在第二季度因聯儲局加息憂慮而升值，主要兌日圓及歐元走強；英鎊則因英國國內政治憂慮消退而表現突出。
managerCommentary.en: Geopolitical risks receded in Q2, with oil prices correcting back to pre-march levels, a whopping -$50 from the high highs seen in March and April. This in turn helped to stabilize yields and allowed risk assets to resume their buoyant performance, led by the tech sector. President Trump’s visit to China also showcased improving relationship between U.S. and China, notwithstanding ongoing rivalries in technology leadership and geopolitical influence. Monetary policy took center stage in the second half of the quarter, in particular with new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh widely seen by the market to be hawkish given his emphasis to meet the 2% inflation target. Global fixed income largely retraced the Q1 decline. The quarter itself was split into two halves, with April seeing most of the market rally, whereas going into June concerns about the hawkish Fed led to significant retracement. Corporate credit spreads tightened notwithstanding concerns about a hawkish Fed, as risk markets remain buoyant. Overall, the dollar appreciated in Q2 over Fed hike concerns, mainly against Japanese yen and Euro, while GBP outperformed as domestic political fears recede.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 受惠於經濟活動展現韌性、企業盈利穩健，以及市場對人工智能相關投資主題持續熱衷，環球市場在2026年第二季度錄得正回報。雖然地緣政治緊張局勢及能源價格高企曾引發間歇性波動，但季末的外交進展改善，有助於支持投資者信心。經濟狀況整體仍然有利。穩健的消費者及企業資產負債表，為美國經濟持續展現韌性提供支持，而領先指標亦與擴張環境吻合。通脹壓力在季初因能源成本上升而加劇，但其後隨油價於季末回落而趨穩。環球股市由科技、半導體及人工智能相關企業領漲，其中美國股市表現優於大部分已發展市場。台灣地區及南韓亦受惠於科技板塊的強勁動能，而中國內地在較具挑戰的增長環境下表現落後。至6月，市場領漲範圍有所擴大，投資者輪動至工業、金融及醫療保健等板塊。展望未來，投資者或將繼續聚焦通脹、央行政策及地緣政治發展。儘管存在此等不明朗因素，但經濟增長具韌性、企業基本面穩健，加上科技驅動的投資趨勢持續，仍為環球市場提供有利的宏觀背景。
managerCommentary.en: Global markets delivered positive returns during the second quarter of 2026, supported by resilient economic activity, solid corporate earnings, and continued enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence-related investment themes. While geopolitical tensions and elevated energy prices created periods of volatility, improving diplomatic developments later in the quarter helped support investor sentiment. Economic conditions remained broadly supportive. The U.S. economy continued to demonstrate resilience, underpinned by healthy consumer and corporate balance sheets, while leading indicators remained consistent with an expansionary environment. Inflation pressures rose earlier in the quarter due to higher energy costs but stabilized as oil prices retreated toward quarter-end. Global equities were led by technology, semiconductor, and AI-related companies, with U.S. equities outperforming most developed markets. Taiwan and Korea also benefited from strong technology-sector momentum, while China lagged amid a more challenging growth backdrop. By June, market leadership broadened as investors rotated toward sectors such as industrials, financials, and health care. Looking ahead, investors are likely to remain focused on inflation, central bank policy, and geopolitical developments. Despite these uncertainties, the combination of resilient growth, healthy corporate fundamentals, and ongoing technology-driven investment trends continues to provide a constructive backdrop for global markets.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 受惠於金融活動及企業利潤帶動的強勁稅收，政府財政重返盈餘，香港經濟復甦範圍持續擴大。儘管持續投資於基礎設施、創新及科技預期將令資本帳赤字持續，但政府計劃透過適度增加債券發行，以及對戰略項目提供定向支持，為相關舉措提供資金。本季度港元本地利率曲線呈熊市平坦化，長端表現優於短端及中段，主要受能源價格高企及經濟數據穩健所推動，市場因而重新定價聯儲局政策預期。香港整體市場情緒仍受三個因素所支持：資金流向穩定、經濟前景日益樂觀，以及市場對中國內地將主動提供財政支持以緩和內需疲弱及關稅影響的信心。本地投資者繼續把握孳息率短暫飆升及港元利率表現落後的機會，將資金配置於具吸引力的港元套息機會。經濟層面方面，零售銷售呈現時好時壞的格局，5月出現復甦，其中百貨公司、珠寶及手錶與鐘錶錄得強勁表現。受惠於新訂單分項指數升至53.2、新產品推出、客戶需求改善及世界盃相關銷售增加，採購經理指數由5月的50.4升至6月的52.0。外部需求維持穩健，出口訂單分項指數為51.8，來自中國內地的新業務分項指數改善至52.7，而失業率在5月維持低位3.7%。
managerCommentary.en: Hong Kong’s economic recovery continues to broaden, with the government returning to a fiscal surplus supported by strong tax revenues from financial activities and corporate profits. While capital deficits are expected to persist due to ongoing investments in infrastructure, innovation, and technology, the government plans to fund these initiatives through a measured increase in bond issuance and targeted support for strategic projects. HKD local rates bear-flattened this quarter, with long-end yields outperforming the front end and belly as Fed expectations were repriced amid higher energy prices and resilient economic data. Overall sentiment in Hong Kong remains underpinned by stable capital flows, improving economic optimism, and confidence in China’s proactive fiscal support to mitigate the effects of weak domestic consumption and tariffs. Domestic investors continue to take advantage of periodic yield spikes and HKD rates underperformance to deploy funds into attractive HKD carry opportunities. On the economic front, retail sales are in a start-stop mode with a recovery in May with department stores and jewelry, watches and clocks posting strong numbers. PMI improved to 52.0 in June from 50.4 in May, supported by stronger new orders at 53.2, new product launches, improved client demand and World Cup-related sales. External demand remained firm, with export orders at 51.8 and business from China improving to 52.7, while unemployment remained low at 3.7% in May.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 第二季度，香港股票投資組合的基準——富時強積金香港指數下跌6.52%。季內，資訊科技、金融及工業板塊表現優於指數，而能源、原材料及非必需消費品板塊則表現落後。4月，中國內地/香港股票的風險偏好回升。在美伊停火後，股市強勁反彈，人工智能基礎設施受益股的漲幅顯著加快。另外，DeepSeek-V4進一步驗證了國產算力在大規模人工智能模型的應用，並強化了國產替代的趨勢。5月份，市場仍緊扣人工智能主題，惟領漲範圍日益收窄，且集中度進一步提升。相比之下，平台互聯網股難以發力，市場情緒因人工智能變現前景不明而受壓。在科技板塊以外，市場未見預期中的流動性外溢至更廣泛的週期性板塊，因為內地經濟活動放緩及盈利表現欠佳，削弱投資者信心。6月份，中國內地/香港股票因投資者獲利了結而大幅調整。儘管PMI數據改善且出口增長穩健，但估值憂慮以及人工智能和科技龍頭股的持倉過於擁擠，令市場情緒受壓。
managerCommentary.en: In the second quarter, the FTSE MPF Hong Kong Index, the benchmark of the Hong Kong equity portfolio, returned -6.52%. Information technology, financials, and industrials sectors outperformed the index, while energy, materials, and consumer discretionary sectors lagged during the quarter. In April, risk appetite rebounded across China and Hong Kong equities. Following the U.S.-Iran ceasefire, equities staged a strong comeback, with gains accelerating sharply across AI infra beneficiaries. Separately, DeepSeek-V4 further validates domestic compute for large-scale AI models and reinforces the trajectory of domestic substitution. In May, the market remained firmly anchored by the AI narrative, though the leadership became increasingly narrow and concentrated. In contrast, platform internet struggled to gain traction, with sentiment capped by uncertain AI monetization. Beyond tech, the market failed to see the anticipated liquidity spillover into broader cyclicals, as softening domestic activity and lackluster earnings delivery weighed on investor confidence. In June, China/Hong Kong equities corrected sharply as investors took profits. Despite improving PMI data and resilient export growth, sentiment was pressured by valuation concerns, crowded positioning in AI and technology leaders.

managerCommentary.zh: 受惠於經濟活動展現韌性、企業盈利穩健，以及市場對人工智能相關投資主題持續熱衷，環球市場在2026年第二季度錄得正回報。雖然地緣政治緊張局勢及能源價格高企曾引發間歇性波動，但季末的外交進展改善，有助於支持投資者信心。經濟狀況整體仍然有利。穩健的消費者及企業資產負債表，為美國經濟持續展現韌性提供支持，而領先指標亦與擴張環境吻合。通脹壓力在季初因能源成本上升而加劇，但其後隨油價於季末回落而趨穩。環球股市由科技、半導體及人工智能相關企業領漲，其中美國股市表現優於大部分已發展市場。台灣地區及南韓亦受惠於科技板塊的強勁動能，而中國內地在較具挑戰的增長環境下表現落後。至6月，市場領漲範圍有所擴大，投資者輪動至工業、金融及醫療保健等板塊。展望未來，投資者或將繼續聚焦通脹、央行政策及地緣政治發展。儘管存在此等不明朗因素，但經濟增長具韌性、企業基本面穩健，加上科技驅動的投資趨勢持續，仍為環球市場提供有利的宏觀背景。
managerCommentary.en: Global markets delivered positive returns during the second quarter of 2026, supported by resilient economic activity, solid corporate earnings, and continued enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence-related investment themes. While geopolitical tensions and elevated energy prices created periods of volatility, improving diplomatic developments later in the quarter helped support investor sentiment. Economic conditions remained broadly supportive. The U.S. economy continued to demonstrate resilience, underpinned by healthy consumer and corporate balance sheets, while leading indicators remained consistent with an expansionary environment. Inflation pressures rose earlier in the quarter due to higher energy costs but stabilized as oil prices retreated toward quarter-end. Global equities were led by technology, semiconductor, and AI-related companies, with U.S. equities outperforming most developed markets. Taiwan and Korea also benefited from strong technology-sector momentum, while China lagged amid a more challenging growth backdrop. By June, market leadership broadened as investors rotated toward sectors such as industrials, financials, and health care. Looking ahead, investors are likely to remain focused on inflation, central bank policy, and geopolitical developments. Despite these uncertainties, the combination of resilient growth, healthy corporate fundamentals, and ongoing technology-driven investment trends continues to provide a constructive backdrop for global markets.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 第二季度的主調，是市場由極度擔憂地緣政治，轉為更審慎評估地緣政治、通脹及結構性力量對環球經濟的長遠影響。股票市場在季初延續了3月底大幅拋售後的反彈走勢，因為投資者對中東衝突的看法日趨樂觀，認為其雖然嚴重，但不太可能對企業盈利造成廣泛的根本性損害，或引發全球經濟衰退。季內，市場焦點逐步從地緣政治事件本身，轉移至能源市場、通脹、貨幣政策與人工智能影響力加速之間的交互作用。本季度的突出特點之一，是在地緣政治風險升溫、通脹壓力持續及利率高企的背景下，環球市場仍展現出非凡韌性。投資者日益將焦點由中東衝突的直接影響，轉向能源安全、貨幣政策及人工智能的長遠影響。儘管經濟基本面依然穩健，但由於環球驅動因素對各地區及資產類別的影響日益加深，實現投資組合多元化亦變得更為困難。在此環境下，盈利持續性、定價能力、資產負債表實力，以及對差異化結構性增長驅動因素的敞口，仍是在日益互聯的環球格局中部署投資的關鍵考量。
managerCommentary.en: The second quarter was defined by a gradual transition from acute geopolitical fear toward a more measured assessment of how persistent geopolitical, inflationary, and structural forces will shape the global economy. Equity markets entered the quarter recovering from the sharp selloff experienced at the end of March as investors grew more confident that the Middle East conflict, while significant, was unlikely to cause widespread fundamental damage to corporate earnings or trigger a global recession. As the quarter progressed, market leadership increasingly shifted away from geopolitical headlines alone and toward the interaction between energy markets, inflation, monetary policy, and the accelerating influence of artificial intelligence. The quarter demonstrated that global markets remain remarkably resilient despite elevated geopolitical risks, persistent inflation pressures, and higher interest rates. Investors increasingly shifted their focus away from the immediate consequences of the Middle East conflict and toward the longer-term implications of energy security, monetary policy, and artificial intelligence. While economic fundamentals remain constructive, diversification has become more difficult to achieve as global drivers increasingly shape outcomes across regions and asset classes. In this environment, earnings durability, pricing power, balance sheet strength, and exposure to differentiated structural growth drivers remain critical factors for navigating an increasingly interconnected global landscape.

managerCommentary.zh: 受惠於經濟活動展現韌性、企業盈利穩健，以及市場對人工智能相關投資主題持續熱衷，環球市場在2026年第二季度錄得正回報。雖然地緣政治緊張局勢及能源價格高企曾引發間歇性波動，但季末的外交進展改善，有助於支持投資者信心。經濟狀況整體仍然有利。穩健的消費者及企業資產負債表，為美國經濟持續展現韌性提供支持，而領先指標亦與擴張環境吻合。通脹壓力在季初因能源成本上升而加劇，但其後隨油價於季末回落而趨穩。環球股市由科技、半導體及人工智能相關企業領漲，其中美國股市表現優於大部分已發展市場。台灣地區及南韓亦受惠於科技板塊的強勁動能，而中國內地在較具挑戰的增長環境下表現落後。至6月，市場領漲範圍有所擴大，投資者輪動至工業、金融及醫療保健等板塊。展望未來，投資者或將繼續聚焦通脹、央行政策及地緣政治發展。儘管存在此等不明朗因素，但經濟增長具韌性、企業基本面穩健，加上科技驅動的投資趨勢持續，仍為環球市場提供有利的宏觀背景。
managerCommentary.en: Global markets delivered positive returns during the second quarter of 2026, supported by resilient economic activity, solid corporate earnings, and continued enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence-related investment themes. While geopolitical tensions and elevated energy prices created periods of volatility, improving diplomatic developments later in the quarter helped support investor sentiment. Economic conditions remained broadly supportive. The U.S. economy continued to demonstrate resilience, underpinned by healthy consumer and corporate balance sheets, while leading indicators remained consistent with an expansionary environment. Inflation pressures rose earlier in the quarter due to higher energy costs but stabilized as oil prices retreated toward quarter-end. Global equities were led by technology, semiconductor, and AI-related companies, with U.S. equities outperforming most developed markets. Taiwan and Korea also benefited from strong technology-sector momentum, while China lagged amid a more challenging growth backdrop. By June, market leadership broadened as investors rotated toward sectors such as industrials, financials, and health care. Looking ahead, investors are likely to remain focused on inflation, central bank policy, and geopolitical developments. Despite these uncertainties, the combination of resilient growth, healthy corporate fundamentals, and ongoing technology-driven investment trends continues to provide a constructive backdrop for global markets.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 受惠於金融活動及企業利潤帶動的強勁稅收，政府財政重返盈餘，香港經濟復甦範圍持續擴大。儘管持續投資於基礎設施、創新及科技預期將令資本帳赤字持續，但政府計劃透過適度增加債券發行，以及對戰略項目提供定向支持，為相關舉措提供資金。本季度港元本地利率曲線呈熊市平坦化，長端表現優於短端及中段，主要受能源價格高企及經濟數據穩健所推動，市場因而重新定價聯儲局政策預期。香港整體市場情緒仍受三個因素所支持：資金流向穩定、經濟前景日益樂觀，以及市場對中國內地將主動提供財政支持以緩和內需疲弱及關稅影響的信心。本地投資者繼續把握孳息率短暫飆升及港元利率表現落後的機會，將資金配置於具吸引力的港元套息機會。經濟層面方面，零售銷售呈現時好時壞的格局，5月出現復甦，其中百貨公司、珠寶及手錶與鐘錶錄得強勁表現。受惠於新訂單分項指數升至53.2、新產品推出、客戶需求改善及世界盃相關銷售增加，採購經理指數由5月的50.4升至6月的52.0。外部需求維持穩健，出口訂單分項指數為51.8，來自中國內地的新業務分項指數改善至52.7，而失業率在5月維持低位3.7%。
managerCommentary.en: Hong Kong’s economic recovery continues to broaden, with the government returning to a fiscal surplus supported by strong tax revenues from financial activities and corporate profits. While capital deficits are expected to persist due to ongoing investments in infrastructure, innovation, and technology, the government plans to fund these initiatives through a measured increase in bond issuance and targeted support for strategic projects. HKD local rates bear-flattened this quarter, with long-end yields outperforming the front end and belly as Fed expectations were repriced amid higher energy prices and resilient economic data. Overall sentiment in Hong Kong remains underpinned by stable capital flows, improving economic optimism, and confidence in China’s proactive fiscal support to mitigate the effects of weak domestic consumption and tariffs. Domestic investors continue to take advantage of periodic yield spikes and HKD rates underperformance to deploy funds into attractive HKD carry opportunities. On the economic front, retail sales are in a start-stop mode with a recovery in May with department stores and jewelry, watches and clocks posting strong numbers. PMI improved to 52.0 in June from 50.4 in May, supported by stronger new orders at 53.2, new product launches, improved client demand and World Cup-related sales. External demand remained firm, with export orders at 51.8 and business from China improving to 52.7, while unemployment remained low at 3.7% in May.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，亞太區（日本除外）股票表現異常強勁，富時強積金亞太區（日本除外）指數以港元計上升22.9%，主要受惠於科技板塊持續強勢，以及市場對人工智能投資週期的樂觀情緒。4月及5月市場大幅反彈，中東地緣政治局勢緩和、半導體及人工智能供應鏈企業第一季盈利強勁，加上美國超大型雲端營運商加大資本開支承諾，均提振了投資者信心，尤以南韓及台灣地區市場表現突出。雖然美國國債孳息率上升及通脹憂慮引發間歇性波動，但科技板塊的盈利上調持續為市場動能提供支撐。6月，市場因憂慮人工智能開支的可持續性、美元走強及美國聯儲局立場轉趨鷹派，而出現部分獲利回吐及整固。與此同時，中國內地及香港期內表現落後，因中國內地經濟數據仍然疲弱。此外，跨境資金管制的加強亦打擊了市場情緒。商品市場表現波動，布蘭特原油在4月因美伊緊張局勢而飆升至每桶110美元以上，其後隨霍爾木茲海峽重開及地緣政治風險緩和，於季末回落至約每桶73美元。板塊方面，資訊科技股在人工智能及數據中心需求持續支持下，成為全季表現最突出的行業；工業及金融板塊亦跑贏大市；而通訊服務及非必需消費品板塊則表現落後。
managerCommentary.en: Asia Pacific ex-Japan equities delivered an exceptionally strong performance in Q2 ‘26, with the FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex-Japan Index rising 22.9% in HKD terms, driven primarily by the continued strength of the technology sector and optimism surrounding the AI investment cycle. Markets rallied sharply in April and May as easing Middle East geopolitical tensions, strong first-quarter earnings from semiconductor and AI supply chain companies, and increased capital expenditure commitments from U.S. hyperscalers boosted investor confidence, particularly in Korea and Taiwan. While rising U.S. Treasury yields and inflation concerns caused periodic volatility, earnings upgrades across the technology sector continued to support market momentum. In June, markets consolidated some of their gains amid concerns over the sustainability of AI spending, a stronger U.S. dollar, and a more hawkish U.S. Federal Reserve stance. Meanwhile, China and Hong Kong underperformed during the quarter as China domestic economic data remained weak. Moreover, the step up in cross-border-capital controls also weighs on market sentiment. Commodity markets were volatile, with Brent crude oil surging above US$110/bbl in April amid U.S.-Iran tensions before retreating to approximately US$73/bbl by quarter-end following the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and easing geopolitical risks. Sector-wise, Information Technology was the standout performer throughout the quarter, supported by persistent AI and data-centre demand, while Industrials and Financials also outperformed, whereas Communication Services and Consumer Discretionary lagged the broader market.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 第二季度地緣政治風險降溫，油價從3月及4月高位大幅回落約50美元，重返3月前水平。債券孳息率隨之回穩，風險資產在科技板塊帶領下重拾升勢。特朗普總統訪華亦反映中美關係有所改善，但雙方在科技主導地位及地緣影響力方面的角力仍然持續。貨幣政策在季度後半段主導市場焦點，聯儲局新任主席凱文 • 沃什（Kevin Warsh）多次強調必須達致2%的通脹目標，市場普遍視之為鷹派訊號。環球固定收益市場大致收復了第一季度的跌幅。本季度可分為上下兩個半段：4月錄得大部分升幅，而接近6月時市場對聯儲局鷹派立場的憂慮引發了顯著回吐。儘管市場憂慮聯儲局鷹派立場，但風險市場保持暢旺，帶動企業信貸息差仍見收窄。整體而言，美元在第二季度因聯儲局加息憂慮而升值，主要兌日圓及歐元走強；英鎊則因英國國內政治憂慮消退而表現突出。
managerCommentary.en: Geopolitical risks receded in Q2, with oil prices correcting back to pre-march levels, a whopping -$50 from the high highs seen in March and April. This in turn helped to stabilize yields and allowed risk assets to resume their buoyant performance, led by the tech sector. President Trump’s visit to China also showcased improving relationship between U.S. and China, notwithstanding ongoing rivalries in technology leadership and geopolitical influence. Monetary policy took center stage in the second half of the quarter, in particular with new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh widely seen by the market to be hawkish given his emphasis to meet the 2% inflation target. Global fixed income largely retraced the Q1 decline. The quarter itself was split into two halves, with April seeing most of the market rally, whereas going into June concerns about the hawkish Fed led to significant retracement. Corporate credit spreads tightened notwithstanding concerns about a hawkish Fed, as risk markets remain buoyant. Overall, the dollar appreciated in Q2 over Fed hike concerns, mainly against Japanese yen and Euro, while GBP outperformed as domestic political fears recede.

managerCommentary.zh: 第二季度，香港股票投資組合的基準——富時強積金香港指數下跌6.52%。季內，資訊科技、金融及工業板塊表現優於指數，而能源、原材料及非必需消費品板塊則表現落後。4月，中國內地/香港股票的風險偏好回升。在美伊停火後，股市強勁反彈，人工智能基礎設施受益股的漲幅顯著加快。另外，DeepSeek-V4進一步驗證了國產算力在大規模人工智能模型的應用，並強化了國產替代的趨勢。5月份，市場仍緊扣人工智能主題，惟領漲範圍日益收窄，且集中度進一步提升。相比之下，平台互聯網股難以發力，市場情緒因人工智能變現前景不明而受壓。在科技板塊以外，市場未見預期中的流動性外溢至更廣泛的週期性板塊，因為內地經濟活動放緩及盈利表現欠佳，削弱投資者信心。6月份，中國內地/香港股票因投資者獲利了結而大幅調整。儘管PMI數據改善且出口增長穩健，但估值憂慮以及人工智能和科技龍頭股的持倉過於擁擠，令市場情緒受壓。
managerCommentary.en: In the second quarter, the FTSE MPF Hong Kong Index, the benchmark of the Hong Kong equity portfolio, returned -6.52%. Information technology, financials, and industrials sectors outperformed the index, while energy, materials, and consumer discretionary sectors lagged during the quarter. In April, risk appetite rebounded across China and Hong Kong equities. Following the U.S.-Iran ceasefire, equities staged a strong comeback, with gains accelerating sharply across AI infra beneficiaries. Separately, DeepSeek-V4 further validates domestic compute for large-scale AI models and reinforces the trajectory of domestic substitution. In May, the market remained firmly anchored by the AI narrative, though the leadership became increasingly narrow and concentrated. In contrast, platform internet struggled to gain traction, with sentiment capped by uncertain AI monetization. Beyond tech, the market failed to see the anticipated liquidity spillover into broader cyclicals, as softening domestic activity and lackluster earnings delivery weighed on investor confidence. In June, China/Hong Kong equities corrected sharply as investors took profits. Despite improving PMI data and resilient export growth, sentiment was pressured by valuation concerns, crowded positioning in AI and technology leaders.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，大中華股票錄得強勁回報，主要受台灣地區股市帶動，其強勢表現足以彌補香港市場的調整。受惠於環球領先科技企業持續投資人工智能基礎設施，台灣地區股市期內為全球表現最佳的股票市場之一。高效能人工智能伺服器及先進半導體組件的強勁需求，持續推動台灣地區科技供應鏈的盈利上調。盈利能見度及增長預期的提升，成為該市場表現突出的關鍵催化因素。相反，香港市場則大幅調整。儘管中東地緣政治局勢在4月趨於穩定，但香港股市在6月因中國內地經濟動能減弱而再次大幅調整。中國監管機構收緊跨境資金管制，進一步打擊了離岸投資者的信心。從宏觀經濟角度來看，中國內地經濟活動仍然疲弱。5月固定資產投資大幅收縮，而零售銷售表現持續令人失望，抑制了市場中人工智能相關板塊以外的投資者情緒。雖然工業生產及生產者物價指數數據略有改善，但這些正面訊號不足以抵銷整體經濟活動的疲弱態勢。
managerCommentary.en: In the second quarter of 2026, Greater China equities delivered strong returns, driven primarily by Taiwan equities, whose strength more than compensated for the correction in the Hong Kong market. Taiwan was one of the best-performing equity markets globally during the period, supported by sustained investment in AI infrastructure by leading global technology companies. Strong demand for high-performance AI servers and advanced semiconductor components continued to drive earnings upgrades across Taiwan's technology supply chain. The resulting improvement in earnings visibility and growth expectations provided a key catalyst for the market's outperformance. On the contrary, in Hong Kong, the market corrected sharply. Although geopolitical tensions in Middle East stabilized in April, Hong Kong equities experienced another sharp correction in June as China's domestic economic momentum weakened. The tightening of cross-border capital controls by Chinese regulators further weighed on offshore investor sentiment. From a macroeconomic perspective, China's domestic activity remained subdued. Fixed-asset investment (FAI) contracted sharply in May, while retail sales continued to disappoint, dampening investor sentiment outside the AI-related segments of the market. Although industrial production (IP) and producer price index (PPI) data showed modest improvement, these positive developments were insufficient to offset the broader weakness in economic activity.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 亞洲投資級別信貸期內表現穩健，繼續優於眾多環球同類信貸，主要受惠於其存續期較短，以及對能源相關干擾的直接敞口有限。區內央行持續聚焦於管理通脹及貨幣穩定。市場表現主要由較高貝塔值國家的信貸息差收窄所帶動。雖然季初息差顯著收窄（尤其在高收益市場），但部分升幅在6月因息差溫和擴闊而有所回吐。儘管如此，亞洲投資級別市場期內表現仍優於環球綜合債券指數。國家層面，印尼在第二季度表現最為強勁，主要受4月大幅反彈所帶動。儘管市場持續關注普拉博沃總統的擴張性財政開支計劃、燃料補貼負擔上升，以及對央行獨立性的質疑，印尼仍錄得此佳績。緊隨印尼強勁表現之後的是其他較高貝塔值市場，包括菲律賓、泰國及馬來西亞，均受惠於期內息差顯著收窄。
managerCommentary.en: In Asia, investment-grade credit delivered resilient performance during the quarter and continued to compare favorably with many global credit peers, supported by its shorter-duration profile and limited direct exposure to energy-related disruptions. Regional central banks remained focused on managing inflation and currency stability. Market performance was largely driven by credit spread compression across higher-beta countries. Although spreads tightened significantly earlier in the quarter, particularly in high yielding markets, some of these gains moderated in June as spreads widened modestly. Nevertheless, the Asia investment-grade market outperformed the Global Aggregate Index over the same period. At the country level, Indonesia was the strongest performer in Q2, led by a sharp rebound in April. This was achieved despite ongoing concerns surrounding President Prabowo's expansive fiscal spending plans, rising fuel subsidy burdens, and questions regarding central bank independence. Indonesia's strong performance was followed by other higher-beta markets, including the Philippines, Thailand, and Malaysia, all of which benefited from meaningful spread tightening during the quarter.

managerCommentary.heading: Fund Commentary 基金評論
managerCommentary.zh: 受惠於經濟活動展現韌性、企業盈利穩健，以及市場對人工智能相關投資主題持續熱衷，環球市場在2026年第二季度錄得正回報。雖然地緣政治緊張局勢及能源價格高企曾引發間歇性波動，但季末的外交進展改善，有助於支持投資者信心。經濟狀況整體仍然有利。穩健的消費者及企業資產負債表，為美國經濟持續展現韌性提供支持，而領先指標亦與擴張環境吻合。通脹壓力在季初因能源成本上升而加劇，但其後隨油價於季末回落而趨穩。環球股市由科技、半導體及人工智能相關企業領漲，其中美國股市表現優於大部分已發展市場。台灣地區及南韓亦受惠於科技板塊的強勁動能，而中國內地在較具挑戰的增長環境下表現落後。至6月，市場領漲範圍有所擴大，投資者輪動至工業、金融及醫療保健等板塊。展望未來，投資者或將繼續聚焦通脹、央行政策及地緣政治發展。儘管存在此等不明朗因素，但經濟增長具韌性、企業基本面穩健，加上科技驅動的投資趨勢持續，仍為環球市場提供有利的宏觀背景。
managerCommentary.en: Global markets delivered positive returns during the second quarter of 2026, supported by resilient economic activity, solid corporate earnings, and continued enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence-related investment themes. While geopolitical tensions and elevated energy prices created periods of volatility, improving diplomatic developments later in the quarter helped support investor sentiment. Economic conditions remained broadly supportive. The U.S. economy continued to demonstrate resilience, underpinned by healthy consumer and corporate balance sheets, while leading indicators remained consistent with an expansionary environment. Inflation pressures rose earlier in the quarter due to higher energy costs but stabilized as oil prices retreated toward quarter-end. Global equities were led by technology, semiconductor, and AI-related companies, with U.S. equities outperforming most developed markets. Taiwan and Korea also benefited from strong technology-sector momentum, while China lagged amid a more challenging growth backdrop. By June, market leadership broadened as investors rotated toward sectors such as industrials, financials, and health care. Looking ahead, investors are likely to remain focused on inflation, central bank policy, and geopolitical developments. Despite these uncertainties, the combination of resilient growth, healthy corporate fundamentals, and ongoing technology-driven investment trends continues to provide a constructive backdrop for global markets.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 第二季度地緣政治風險降溫，油價從3月及4月高位大幅回落約50美元，重返3月前水平。債券孳息率隨之回穩，風險資產在科技板塊帶領下重拾升勢。特朗普總統訪華亦反映中美關係有所改善，但雙方在科技主導地位及地緣影響力方面的角力仍然持續。貨幣政策在季度後半段主導市場焦點，聯儲局新任主席凱文 · 沃什（Kevin Warsh）多次強調必須達致2%的通脹目標，市場普遍視之為鷹派訊號。環球固定收益市場大致收復了第一季度的跌幅。本季度可分為上下兩個半段：4月錄得大部分升幅，而接近6月時市場對聯儲局鷹派立場的憂慮引發了顯著回吐。儘管市場憂慮聯儲局鷹派立場，但風險市場保持暢旺，帶動企業信貸息差仍見收窄。整體而言，美元在第二季度因聯儲局加息憂慮而升值，主要兌日圓及歐元走強；英鎊則因英國國內政治憂慮消退而表現突出。
managerCommentary.en: Geopolitical risks receded in Q2, with oil prices correcting back to pre-march levels, a whopping -$50 from the high highs seen in March and April. This in turn helped to stabilize yields and allowed risk assets to resume their buoyant performance, led by the tech sector. President Trump’s visit to China also showcased improving relationship between U.S. and China, notwithstanding ongoing rivalries in technology leadership and geopolitical influence. Monetary policy took center stage in the second half of the quarter, in particular with new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh widely seen by the market to be hawkish given his emphasis to meet the 2% inflation target.Global fixed income largely retraced the Q1 decline. The quarter itself was split into two halves, with April seeing most of the market rally, whereas going into June concerns about the hawkish Fed led to significant retracement. Corporate credit spreads tightened notwithstanding concerns about a hawkish Fed, as risk markets remain buoyant. Overall, the dollar appreciated in Q2 over Fed hike concerns, mainly against Japanese yen and Euro, while GBP outperformed as domestic political fears recede.

managerCommentary.zh: 第二季度，香港股票投資組合的基準——富時強積金香港指數下跌6.52%。季內，資訊科技、金融及工業板塊表現優於指數，而能源、原材料及非必需消費品板塊則表現落後。4月，中國內地/香港股票的風險偏好回升。在美伊停火後，股市強勁反彈，人工智能基礎設施受益股的漲幅顯著加快。另外，DeepSeek-V4進一步驗證了國產算力在大規模人工智能模型的應用，並強化了國產替代的趨勢。5月份，市場仍緊扣人工智能主題，惟領漲範圍日益收窄，且集中度進一步提升。相比之下，平台互聯網股難以發力，市場情緒因人工智能變現前景不明而受壓。在科技板塊以外，市場未見預期中的流動性外溢至更廣泛的週期性板塊，因為內地經濟活動放緩及盈利表現欠佳，削弱投資者信心。6月份，中國內地/香港股票因投資者獲利了結而大幅調整。儘管PMI數據改善且出口增長穩健，但估值憂慮以及人工智能和科技龍頭股的持倉過於擁擠，令市場情緒受壓。
managerCommentary.en: In the second quarter, the FTSE MPF Hong Kong Index, the benchmark of the Hong Kong equity portfolio, returned -6.52%. Information technology, financials, and industrials sectors outperformed the index, while energy, materials, and consumer discretionary sectors lagged during the quarter. In April, risk appetite rebounded across China and Hong Kong equities. Following the U.S.-Iran ceasefire, equities staged a strong comeback, with gains accelerating sharply across AI infra beneficiaries. Separately, DeepSeek-V4 further validates domestic compute for large-scale AI models and reinforces the trajectory of domestic substitution. In May, the market remained firmly anchored by the AI narrative, though the leadership became increasingly narrow and concentrated. In contrast, platform internet struggled to gain traction, with sentiment capped by uncertain AI monetization. Beyond tech, the market failed to see the anticipated liquidity spillover into broader cyclicals, as softening domestic activity and lackluster earnings delivery weighed on investor confidence. In June, China/Hong Kong equities corrected sharply as investors took profits. Despite improving PMI data and resilient export growth, sentiment was pressured by valuation concerns, crowded positioning in AI and technology leaders.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 第二季度的主調，是市場由極度擔憂地緣政治，轉為更審慎評估地緣政治、通脹及結構性力量對環球經濟的長遠影響。股票市場在季初延續了3月底大幅拋售後的反彈走勢，因為投資者對中東衝突的看法日趨樂觀，認為其雖然嚴重，但不太可能對企業盈利造成廣泛的根本性損害，或引發全球經濟衰退。季內，市場焦點逐步從地緣政治事件本身，轉移至能源市場、通脹、貨幣政策與人工智能影響力加速之間的交互作用。本季度的突出特點之一，是在地緣政治風險升溫、通脹壓力持續及利率高企的背景下，環球市場仍展現出非凡韌性。投資者日益將焦點由中東衝突的直接影響，轉向能源安全、貨幣政策及人工智能的長遠影響。儘管經濟基本面依然穩健，但由於環球驅動因素對各地區及資產類別的影響日益加深，實現投資組合多元化亦變得更為困難。在此環境下，盈利持續性、定價能力、資產負債表實力，以及對差異化結構性增長驅動因素的敞口，仍是在日益互聯的環球格局中部署投資的關鍵考量。
managerCommentary.en: The second quarter was defined by a gradual transition from acute geopolitical fear toward a more measured assessment of how persistent geopolitical, inflationary, and structural forces will shape the global economy. Equity markets entered the quarter recovering from the sharp selloff experienced at the end of March as investors grew more confident that the Middle East conflict, while significant, was unlikely to cause widespread fundamental damage to corporate earnings or trigger a global recession. As the quarter progressed, market leadership increasingly shifted away from geopolitical headlines alone and toward the interaction between energy markets, inflation, monetary policy, and the accelerating influence of artificial intelligence.The quarter demonstrated that global markets remain remarkably resilient despite elevated geopolitical risks, persistent inflation pressures, and higher interest rates. Investors increasingly shifted their focus away from the immediate consequences of the Middle East conflict and toward the longer-term implications of energy security, monetary policy, and artificial intelligence. While economic fundamentals remain constructive, diversification has become more difficult to achieve as global drivers increasingly shape outcomes across regions and asset classes. In this environment, earnings durability, pricing power, balance sheet strength, and exposure to differentiated structural growth drivers remain critical factors for navigating an increasingly interconnected global landscape.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，亞太區（日本除外）股票表現異常強勁，富時強積金亞太區（日本除外）指數以港元計上升22.9%，主要受惠於科技板塊持續強勢，以及市場對人工智能投資週期的樂觀情緒。4月及5月市場大幅反彈，中東地緣政治局勢緩和、半導體及人工智能供應鏈企業第一季盈利強勁，加上美國超大型雲端營運商加大資本開支承諾，均提振了投資者信心，尤以南韓及台灣地區市場表現突出。雖然美國國債孳息率上升及通脹憂慮引發間歇性波動，但科技板塊的盈利上調持續為市場動能提供支撐。6月，市場因憂慮人工智能開支的可持續性、美元走強及美國聯儲局立場轉趨鷹派，而出現部分獲利回吐及整固。與此同時，中國內地及香港期內表現落後，因中國內地經濟數據仍然疲弱。此外，跨境資金管制的加強亦打擊了市場情緒。商品市場表現波動，布蘭特原油在4月因美伊緊張局勢而飆升至每桶110美元以上，其後隨霍爾木茲海峽重開及地緣政治風險緩和，於季末回落至約每桶73美元。板塊方面，資訊科技股在人工智能及數據中心需求持續支持下，成為全季表現最突出的行業；工業及金融板塊亦跑贏大市；而通訊服務及非必需消費品板塊則表現落後。
managerCommentary.en: Asia Pacific ex-Japan equities delivered an exceptionally strong performance in Q2 ‘26, with the FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex-Japan Index rising 22.9% in HKD terms, driven primarily by the continued strength of the technology sector and optimism surrounding the AI investment cycle. Markets rallied sharply in April and May as easing Middle East geopolitical tensions, strong first-quarter earnings from semiconductor and AI supply chain companies, and increased capital expenditure commitments from U.S. hyperscalers boosted investor confidence, particularly in Korea and Taiwan. While rising U.S. Treasury yields and inflation concerns caused periodic volatility, earnings upgrades across the technology sector continued to support market momentum. In June, markets consolidated some of their gains amid concerns over the sustainability of AI spending, a stronger U.S. dollar, and a more hawkish U.S. Federal Reserve stance. Meanwhile, China and Hong Kong underperformed during the quarter as China domestic economic data remained weak. Moreover, the step up in cross-border-capital controls also weighs on market sentiment. Commodity markets were volatile, with Brent crude oil surging above US$110/bbl in April amid U.S.-Iran tensions before retreating to approximately US$73/bbl by quarter-end following the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and easing geopolitical risks. Sector-wise, Information Technology was the standout performer throughout the quarter, supported by persistent AI and data-centre demand, while Industrials and Financials also outperformed, whereas Communication Services and Consumer Discretionary lagged the broader market.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 受惠於經濟活動展現韌性、企業盈利穩健，以及市場對人工智能相關投資主題持續熱衷，環球市場在2026年第二季度錄得正回報。雖然地緣政治緊張局勢及能源價格高企曾引發間歇性波動，但季末的外交進展改善，有助於支持投資者信心。經濟狀況整體仍然有利。穩健的消費者及企業資產負債表，為美國經濟持續展現韌性提供支持，而領先指標亦與擴張環境吻合。通脹壓力在季初因能源成本上升而加劇，但其後隨油價於季末回落而趨穩。環球股市由科技、半導體及人工智能相關企業領漲，其中美國股市表現優於大部分已發展市場。台灣地區及南韓亦受惠於科技板塊的強勁動能，而中國內地在較具挑戰的增長環境下表現落後。至6月，市場領漲範圍有所擴大，投資者輪動至工業、金融及醫療保健等板塊。展望未來，投資者或將繼續聚焦通脹、央行政策及地緣政治發展。儘管存在此等不明朗因素，但經濟增長具韌性、企業基本面穩健，加上科技驅動的投資趨勢持續，仍為環球市場提供有利的宏觀背景。
managerCommentary.en: Global markets delivered positive returns during the second quarter of 2026, supported by resilient economic activity, solid corporate earnings, and continued enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence-related investment themes. While geopolitical tensions and elevated energy prices created periods of volatility, improving diplomatic developments later in the quarter helped support investor sentiment. Economic conditions remained broadly supportive. The U.S. economy continued to demonstrate resilience, underpinned by healthy consumer and corporate balance sheets, while leading indicators remained consistent with an expansionary environment. Inflation pressures rose earlier in the quarter due to higher energy costs but stabilized as oil prices retreated toward quarter-end.Global equities were led by technology, semiconductor, and AI-related companies, with U.S. equities outperforming most developed markets. Taiwan and Korea also benefited from strong technology-sector momentum, while China lagged amid a more challenging growth backdrop. By June, market leadership broadened as investors rotated toward sectors such as industrials, financials, and health care.Looking ahead, investors are likely to remain focused on inflation, central bank policy, and geopolitical developments. Despite these uncertainties, the combination of resilient growth, healthy corporate fundamentals, and ongoing technology-driven investment trends continues to provide a constructive backdrop for global markets.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 第二季度，標普500指數錄得15.10%的回報，主要由資訊科技板塊的強勁表現所帶動。能源及公用事業為季內僅有的兩個表現拖累板塊。本季度的整體基調（尤其是4月）是環球市場走勢主要由情緒及技術因素主導，而非基本面驅動。即使面對中東地緣政治風險升溫及能源與通脹的因素，市場的主導力量仍是人工智能浪潮——投資者試圖辨別當中的受益者與受衝擊者，導致市場僅由少數股份領漲。散戶及其他動能投資者主導市場，形成「動能追逐動能」的局面，令股份價格的急升急跌進一步加劇，其他因素幾近被忽視。在標普500指數中，第二季度的因子表現偏好高動能、高波動及優質企業，而股息收益率及價值因子則明顯落後。大型股整體表現優於小型股。
managerCommentary.en: In Q2, the S&P 500 Index returned 15.10%, led by strong performance in Information Technology. Energy and Utilities were the only two detracting sectors for the quarter. The quarter’s overarching message, April in particular, was a classic period of global markets trading on sentiment and technicals, rather than fundamentals. Even through Middle East geopolitical risk elevation and energy/inflation considerations, the dominant driver has been the AI phenomenon as investors try and determine “friend or foe” dynamics leading to a narrow market of winners. Hyperbolic share price movement, up and down, have been further exacerbated by retail and other momentum buyers dominating as “momentum follows momentum” to the expense of everything else. Within the S&P 500 Index, factor performance in the second quarter favored high momentum, high volatility, and higher-quality companies, while dividend yield and value lagged meaningfully. Larger-cap stocks generally held up better than smaller-cap names.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 受惠於金融活動及企業利潤帶動的強勁稅收，政府財政重返盈餘，香港經濟復甦範圍持續擴大。儘管持續投資於基礎設施、創新及科技預期將令資本帳赤字持續，但政府計劃透過適度增加債券發行，以及對戰略項目提供定向支持，為相關舉措提供資金。本季度港元本地利率曲線呈熊市平坦化，長端表現優於短端及中段，主要受能源價格高企及經濟數據穩健所推動，市場因而重新定價聯儲局政策預期。香港整體市場情緒仍受三個因素所支持：資金流向穩定、經濟前景日益樂觀，以及市場對中國內地將主動提供財政支持以緩和內需疲弱及關稅影響的信心。本地投資者繼續把握孳息率短暫飆升及港元利率表現落後的機會，將資金配置於具吸引力的港元套息機會。經濟層面方面，零售銷售呈現時好時壞的格局，5月出現復甦，其中百貨公司、珠寶及手錶與鐘錶錄得強勁表現。受惠於新訂單分項指數升至53.2、新產品推出、客戶需求改善及世界盃相關銷售增加，採購經理指數由5月的50.4升至6月的52.0。外部需求維持穩健，出口訂單分項指數為51.8，來自中國內地的新業務分項指數改善至52.7，而失業率在5月維持低位3.7%。
managerCommentary.en: Hong Kong’s economic recovery continues to broaden, with the government returning to a fiscal surplus supported by strong tax revenues from financial activities and corporate profits. While capital deficits are expected to persist due to ongoing investments in infrastructure, innovation, and technology, the government plans to fund these initiatives through a measured increase in bond issuance and targeted support for strategic projects.HKD local rates bear-flattened this quarter, with long-end yields outperforming the front end and belly as Fed expectations were repriced amid higher energy prices and resilient economic data. Overall sentiment in Hong Kong remains underpinned by stable capital flows, improving economic optimism, and confidence in China’s proactive fiscal support to mitigate the effects of weak domestic consumption and tariffs. Domestic investors continue to take advantage of periodic yield spikes and HKD rates underperformance to deploy funds into attractive HKD carry opportunities. On the economic front, retail sales are in a start-stop mode with a recovery in May with department stores and jewelry, watches and clocks posting strong numbers. PMI improved to 52.0 in June from 50.4 in May, supported by stronger new orders at 53.2, new product launches, improved client demand and World Cup-related sales. External demand remained firm, with export orders at 51.8 and business from China improving to 52.7, while unemployment remained low at 3.7% in May.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 受惠於經濟活動展現韌性、企業盈利穩健，以及市場對人工智能相關投資主題持續熱衷，環球市場在2026年第二季度錄得正回報。雖然地緣政治緊張局勢及能源價格高企曾引發間歇性波動，但季末的外交進展改善，有助於支持投資者信心。經濟狀況整體仍然有利。穩健的消費者及企業資產負債表，為美國經濟持續展現韌性提供支持，而領先指標亦與擴張環境吻合。通脹壓力在季初因能源成本上升而加劇，但其後隨油價於季末回落而趨穩。環球股市由科技、半導體及人工智能相關企業領漲，其中美國股市表現優於大部分已發展市場。台灣地區及南韓亦受惠於科技板塊的強勁動能，而中國內地在較具挑戰的增長環境下表現落後。至6月，市場領漲範圍有所擴大，投資者輪動至工業、金融及醫療保健等板塊。展望未來，投資者或將繼續聚焦通脹、央行政策及地緣政治發展。儘管存在此等不明朗因素，但經濟增長具韌性、企業基本面穩健，加上科技驅動的投資趨勢持續，仍為環球市場提供有利的宏觀背景。
managerCommentary.en: Global markets delivered positive returns during the second quarter of 2026, supported by resilient economic activity, solid corporate earnings, and continued enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence-related investment themes. While geopolitical tensions and elevated energy prices created periods of volatility, improving diplomatic developments later in the quarter helped support investor sentiment. Economic conditions remained broadly supportive. The U.S. economy continued to demonstrate resilience, underpinned by healthy consumer and corporate balance sheets, while leading indicators remained consistent with an expansionary environment. Inflation pressures rose earlier in the quarter due to higher energy costs but stabilized as oil prices retreated toward quarter-end.Global equities were led by technology, semiconductor, and AI-related companies, with U.S. equities outperforming most developed markets. Taiwan and Korea also benefited from strong technology-sector momentum, while China lagged amid a more challenging growth backdrop. By June, market leadership broadened as investors rotated toward sectors such as industrials, financials, and health care.Looking ahead, investors are likely to remain focused on inflation, central bank policy, and geopolitical developments. Despite these uncertainties, the combination of resilient growth, healthy corporate fundamentals, and ongoing technology-driven investment trends continues to provide a constructive backdrop for global markets.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季度，大中華股票錄得強勁回報，主要受台灣地區股市帶動，其強勢表現足以彌補香港市場的調整。受惠於環球領先科技企業持續投資人工智能基礎設施，台灣地區股市期內為全球表現最佳的股票市場之一。高效能人工智能伺服器及先進半導體組件的強勁需求，持續推動台灣地區科技供應鏈的盈利上調。盈利能見度及增長預期的提升，成為該市場表現突出的關鍵催化因素。相反，香港市場則大幅調整。儘管中東地緣政治局勢在4月趨於穩定，但香港股市在6月因中國內地經濟動能減弱而再次大幅調整。中國監管機構收緊跨境資金管制，進一步打擊了離岸投資者的信心。從宏觀經濟角度來看，中國內地經濟活動仍然疲弱。5月固定資產投資大幅收縮，而零售銷售表現持續令人失望，抑制了市場中人工智能相關板塊以外的投資者情緒。雖然工業生產及生產者物價指數數據略有改善，但這些正面訊號不足以抵銷整體經濟活動的疲弱態勢。
managerCommentary.en: In the second quarter of 2026, Greater China equities delivered strong returns, driven primarily by Taiwan equities, whose strength more than compensated for the correction in the Hong Kong market. Taiwan was one of the best-performing equity markets globally during the period, supported by sustained investment in AI infrastructure by leading global technology companies. Strong demand for high-performance AI servers and advanced semiconductor components continued to drive earnings upgrades across Taiwan's technology supply chain. The resulting improvement in earnings visibility and growth expectations provided a key catalyst for the market's outperformance. On the contrary, in Hong Kong, the market corrected sharply. Although geopolitical tensions in Middle East stabilized in April, Hong Kong equities experienced another sharp correction in June as China's domestic economic momentum weakened. The tightening of cross-border capital controls by Chinese regulators further weighed on offshore investor sentiment. From a macroeconomic perspective, China's domestic activity remained subdued. Fixed-asset investment (FAI) contracted sharply in May, while retail sales continued to disappoint, dampening investor sentiment outside the AI-related segments of the market. Although industrial production (IP) and producer price index (PPI) data showed modest improvement, these positive developments were insufficient to offset the broader weakness in economic activity.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh:
第二季度，香港股票投資組合的基準——富時強積金香港指數下跌6.52%。季內，資訊科技、金融及工業板塊表現優於指數，而能源、原材料及非必需消費品板塊則表現落後。4月，中國內地/香港股票的風險偏好回升。在美伊停火後，股市強勁反彈，人工智能基礎設施受益股的漲幅顯著加快。另外，DeepSeek-V4進一步驗證了國產算力在大規模人工智能模型的應用，並強化了國產替代的趨勢。5月份，市場仍緊扣人工智能主題，惟領漲範圍日益收窄，且集中度進一步提升。相比之下，平台互聯網股難以發力，市場情緒因人工智能變現前景不明而受壓。在科技板塊以外，市場未見預期中的流動性外溢至更廣泛的週期性板塊，因為內地經濟活動放緩及盈利表現欠佳，削弱投資者信心。6月份，中國內地/香港股票因投資者獲利了結而大幅調整。儘管PMI數據改善且出口增長穩健，但估值憂慮以及人工智能和科技龍頭股的持倉過於擁擠，令市場情緒受壓。
此項基金旨在提供緊貼恒生指數的表現之投資回報，並受制於追蹤誤差風險、被動式投資風險、未能以貼近盈富基金資產淨值的價格進行買賣的風險及恒生指數的風險因素。有關與此基金相關的風險因素，請參閱強積金計劃說明書。同時，亦請參閱強積金計劃說明書內之恒生指數的免責聲明。
managerCommentary.en:
In the second quarter, the FTSE MPF Hong Kong Index, the benchmark of the Hong Kong equity portfolio, returned -6.52%. Information technology, financials, and industrials sectors outperformed the index, while energy, materials, and consumer discretionary sectors lagged during the quarter. In April, risk appetite rebounded across China and Hong Kong equities. Following the U.S.-Iran ceasefire, equities staged a strong comeback, with gains accelerating sharply across AI infra beneficiaries. Separately, DeepSeek-V4 further validates domestic compute for large-scale AI models and reinforces the trajectory of domestic substitution. In May, the market remained firmly anchored by the AI narrative, though the leadership became increasingly narrow and concentrated. In contrast, platform internet struggled to gain traction, with sentiment capped by uncertain AI monetization. Beyond tech, the market failed to see the anticipated liquidity spillover into broader cyclicals, as softening domestic activity and lackluster earnings delivery weighed on investor confidence. In June, China/Hong Kong equities corrected sharply as investors took profits. Despite improving PMI data and resilient export growth, sentiment was pressured by valuation concerns, crowded positioning in AI and technology leaders.
The fund aims to provide investment results that closely correspond to the performance of the Hang Seng Index and is subject to tracking error risk, passive investment risk, risk of not being able to buy or sell at a price close to the net asset value of the Tracker Fund of Hong Kong and other risk factors associated with Hang Seng Index. Please refer to the MPF Scheme Brochure for risk factors associated with this fund. Please also refer to the disclaimer in relation to Hang Seng Index in the MPF Scheme Brochure.

managerCommentary.zh: 受惠於經濟活動展現韌性、企業盈利穩健，以及市場對人工智能相關投資主題持續熱衷，環球市場在2026年第二季度錄得正回報。雖然地緣政治緊張局勢及能源價格高企曾引發間歇性波動，但季末的外交進展改善，有助於支持投資者信心。經濟狀況整體仍然有利。穩健的消費者及企業資產負債表，為美國經濟持續展現韌性提供支持，而領先指標亦與擴張環境吻合。通脹壓力在季初因能源成本上升而加劇，但其後隨油價於季末回落而趨穩。環球股市由科技、半導體及人工智能相關企業領漲，其中美國股市表現優於大部分已發展市場。台灣地區及南韓亦受惠於科技板塊的強勁動能，而中國內地在較具挑戰的增長環境下表現落後。至6月，市場領漲範圍有所擴大，投資者輪動至工業、金融及醫療保健等板塊。展望未來，投資者或將繼續聚焦通脹、央行政策及地緣政治發展。儘管存在此等不明朗因素，但經濟增長具韌性、企業基本面穩健，加上科技驅動的投資趨勢持續，仍為環球市場提供有利的宏觀背景。
managerCommentary.en: Global markets delivered positive returns during the second quarter of 2026, supported by resilient economic activity, solid corporate earnings, and continued enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence-related investment themes. While geopolitical tensions and elevated energy prices created periods of volatility, improving diplomatic developments later in the quarter helped support investor sentiment. Economic conditions remained broadly supportive. The U.S. economy continued to demonstrate resilience, underpinned by healthy consumer and corporate balance sheets, while leading indicators remained consistent with an expansionary environment. Inflation pressures rose earlier in the quarter due to higher energy costs but stabilized as oil prices retreated toward quarter-end.Global equities were led by technology, semiconductor, and AI-related companies, with U.S. equities outperforming most developed markets. Taiwan and Korea also benefited from strong technology-sector momentum, while China lagged amid a more challenging growth backdrop. By June, market leadership broadened as investors rotated toward sectors such as industrials, financials, and health care.Looking ahead, investors are likely to remain focused on inflation, central bank policy, and geopolitical developments. Despite these uncertainties, the combination of resilient growth, healthy corporate fundamentals, and ongoing technology-driven investment trends continues to provide a constructive backdrop for global markets.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 亞洲投資級別信貸期內表現穩健，繼續優於眾多環球同類信貸，主要受惠於其存續期較短，以及對能源相關干擾的直接敞口有限。區內央行持續聚焦於管理通脹及貨幣穩定。市場表現主要由較高貝塔值國家的信貸息差收窄所帶動。雖然季初息差顯著收窄（尤其在高收益市場），但部分升幅在6月因息差溫和擴闊而有所回吐。儘管如此，亞洲投資級別市場期內表現仍優於環球綜合債券指數。國家層面，印尼在第二季度表現最為強勁，主要受4月大幅反彈所帶動。儘管市場持續關注普拉博沃總統的擴張性財政開支計劃、燃料補貼負擔上升，以及對央行獨立性的質疑，印尼仍錄得此佳績。緊隨印尼強勁表現之後的是其他較高貝塔值市場，包括菲律賓、泰國及馬來西亞，均受惠於期內息差顯著收窄。
managerCommentary.en: In Asia, investment-grade credit delivered resilient performance during the quarter and continued to compare favorably with many global credit peers, supported by its shorter-duration profile and limited direct exposure to energy-related disruptions. Regional central banks remained focused on managing inflation and currency stability. Market performance was largely driven by credit spread compression across higher-beta countries. Although spreads tightened significantly earlier in the quarter, particularly in high yielding markets, some of these gains moderated in June as spreads widened modestly. Nevertheless, the Asia investment-grade market outperformed the Global Aggregate Index over the same period. At the country level, Indonesia was the strongest performer in Q2, led by a sharp rebound in April. This was achieved despite ongoing concerns surrounding President Prabowo's expansive fiscal spending plans, rising fuel subsidy burdens, and questions regarding central bank independence. Indonesia's strong performance was followed by other higher-beta markets, including the Philippines, Thailand, and Malaysia, all of which benefited from meaningful spread tightening during the quarter.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 環球股市於8月份錄得穩健升幅，主要由美國股市帶動。月初企業盈利維持韌性，加上美元轉弱利好新興市場回報，均為股市提供支持。儘管月中半導體股遭到拋售，令升勢受阻，區內指數仍錄得正回報，主要受投資者趁低吸納台灣及南韓半導體股份所帶動。美國國庫債券長期部分持續受壓，30年期孳息率升至2007年以來最高水平。通脹數據則發出不同訊號，核心消費物價指數及核心個人消費開支物價指數均符合市場預期，但仍遠高於聯儲局2%的目標。
managerCommentary.en: Global equities posted solid gains in August, led by US and supported by resilient corporate earnings early in the month and a weaker dollar boosting EM returns. Although, semiconductor sell-off in mid-month disrupted the rally, with regional index still post positive gain, mainly attributed by bottom fishing by investors in the semi-sector across Taiwan and Korea. US Treasuries came under sustained pressure at the long end – the 30 year yield hit its highest since 2007. As inflation data sent mixed signals between core CPI and core PCE which came in in-line with consensus but well above the Fed’s 2% target.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 環球市場維持相對穩定，具韌性的經濟增長抵銷地緣政治風險憂慮，而通脹放緩則支持市場預期主要央行將對政策調整保持耐性。香港政府債券孳息率曲線跟隨美國國庫債券孳息率曲線輕微上移，其中6個月期孳息率上升13個基點至2.79%，2年期孳息率亦上升13個基點至3.15%。受美國通脹持續偏高的預期及政策預期收緊影響，兩者的孳息率曲線均趨陡。1個月香港銀行同業拆息於8月份由2.68%下跌至約2.5%，反映香港流動性充裕及融資狀況穩定。美元兌港元於聯繫匯率制度的兌換範圍內維持穩定。
managerCommentary.en: Global markets remained relatively stable as resilient economic growth offset concerns over geopolitical risks and moderating inflation supported expectations that major central banks would remain patient on policy adjustments. Hong Kong government bond curve rose modestly with US treasury curve, with 6 Month yield rose 13 bps to 2.79% and 2 Years yield rose 13 bps to 3.15%. Both curve steepened due to US sticky inflation and potential tighten policy expectation. 1-month HIBOR declined from 2.68% to around 2.5% during August, reflecting ample liquidity and stable funding conditions in Hong Kong. USD/HKD remained stable within the Linked Exchange Rate System trading band.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金評論 Fund Commentary
managerCommentary.zh: 香港及中國股市於8月份輕微下跌，中國經濟數據反映具韌性的外部需求與仍在復甦的內部消費環境之間出現分歧。各行業回報表現分歧，中國資訊科技及人工智能相關行業從7月份的調整中反彈；而包括傳統互聯網及消費行業在內的7月份表現領先板塊則出現整固，扭轉7月份走勢。我們對2026年餘下時間的前景維持正面看法。具韌性的出口需求，尤其是科技相關及先進製造業，繼續為較疲弱的內部經濟活動提供重要支持。
managerCommentary.en: HK & China market was mildly weaker in August, as economic data in China reflected a divergence between resilient external demand and a still-recovering domestic consumption environment. Returns across sectors remained mixed, with China I.T. and AI related industries rebounded from July correction, whilst July outperformers including traditional internet and consumer sectors consolidated, reversing July trend. We remain constructive on the outlook for the remainder of 2026. Resilient export demand, particularly in technology-related and advanced manufacturing sectors, continues to provide an important offset to softer domestic activity.

managerCommentary.zh: 債券市場於8月份表現分歧，企業債券普遍跑贏政府債券。表現方面，美國國庫債券及英國國債於8月份分別錄得0.33%及0.20%回報。由於歐元區通脹升至近三年來最高水平，德國政府債券表現落後，錄得-0.53%回報。相較之下，企業債券市場表現較具韌性，並受到企業資產負債表穩健、收益需求強勁及信貸息差收窄所支持。通脹憂慮、財政壓力、債券發行增加及市場對央行政策預期的轉變，均拖累政府債券表現，並推動長期債券孳息率升至多年高位。此情況遍及全球，影響美國、英國、歐元區及日本市場。美國財政部宣布將長期國庫債券回購規模由每次操作20億美元增至至少40億美元。美國國庫債券一度上升，但升勢短暫，市場焦點其後重回龐大財政赤字及大量債券發行等根本問題。月內，我們大致維持現有存續期配置，並選擇性增持投資級別企業債券，以降低投資組合的低配幅度。
managerCommentary.en: A mixed month for bond markets where corporate bonds generally outperformed government bonds. In terms of performance, US treasuries and UK gilts returned 0.33% and 0.20% respectively in August. With euro-area inflation jumping to its highest level in almost three years, German bunds underperformed, returning -0.53%. By contrast, corporate bond markets proved more resilient, supported by healthy company balance sheets, strong demand for income and tight credit spreads. Inflation concerns, fiscal pressures, increased issuance and changing expectations for central bank policy weighed on the performance of government bonds, pushing yields on long-dated debt to multi-year highs. This was a global phenomenon, affecting the US, UK, eurozone and Japan. The US treasury announced the buybacks of long-dated treasuries from $2 billion per operation to at least $4 billion. Treasuries initially rallied on the news, but it was short-lived as markets focused on the underlying issues of a large fiscal deficit and heavy issuance. Over the month we maintained broad duration exposures and added selectively to investment grade corporate bonds to reduce an underweight exposure.

managerCommentary.zh: 亞洲（日本除外）股市於前數月調整後在8月份強勁反彈，受區內大部分市場經濟活動維持韌性及投資者情緒改善所支持。北亞是區內表現較佳的市場之一，受惠於市場持續看好人工智能及半導體相關供應鏈。儘管各行業回報表現分歧，香港及中國股市在指數層面則大致橫行。亞洲長期前景維持正面，並受到具韌性的外部需求及持續的科技投資所支持。
managerCommentary.en: Asia ex Japan markets staged a strong rebound in August following the correction seen in previous months, supported by resilient economic activity across much of the region and improving investor sentiment. North Asia was among the region’s stronger-performing markets, benefiting from continued enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence and semiconductor-related supply chains. HK & China at index level traded sideways despite mixed return across sectors. Asia long-term outlook remains constructive, supported by a combination of resilient external demand and continued technology investment.
