managerCommentary.zh: 在中國，政策制定者繼續將2026年GDP成長目標設定在4.5%至5.0%，同時維持寬鬆的貨幣政策立場並謹慎管理流動性狀況。通膨動態持續改善，中國4月PPI年增2.8%，此前2025年PPI持續疲軟；預計2026年CPI平均漲幅約1%。中國5月份的經濟活動數據整體不如預期，凸顯了出口相對強勁與內需疲軟之間持續存在的分化。在香港，貨幣狀況主要受聯繫匯率制度和美國利率走勢的影響。港幣流動性仍充裕，有助於在國際市場波動的情況下維持有序的融資環境。
managerCommentary.en: In China, policymakers continued to target 2026 GDP growth of 4.5%–5.0%, while maintaining an accommodative monetary stance and carefully managing liquidity conditions. Inflation dynamics continued to improve, with China's PPI rising 2.8% year-on-year in April after prolonged weakness in 2025, while CPI is expected to average around 1% for 2026. China's May activity data generally disappointed expectations, highlighting ongoing divergence between relatively strong exports and softer domestic demand. In Hong Kong, monetary conditions remained largely driven by the Linked Exchange Rate System and developments in US interest rates. HKD liquidity remained ample, helping to maintain orderly funding conditions despite fluctuations in global markets.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理評論
managerCommentary.zh: 2026年第二季，標普500指數上升14.4%。中東地緣政治緊張局勢緩和、油價回落以及企業盈利表現穩健，共同推動美國股市大幅反彈。隨著美伊停火協議達成，市場對伊朗衝突的憂慮逐步消退，加上美國經濟增長前景保持穩健，投資者情緒持續改善。市場升勢主要由成長型板塊帶動，當中科技股表現尤為突出，反映投資者對經濟增長與通脹風險取得平衡的信心有所提升。人工智能投資周期繼續成為市場的核心主題。資金持續流入半導體、人工智能基礎設施、數據中心及雲端服務等領域，多家領先半導體企業錄得創紀錄的盈利表現，進一步鞏固市場對人工智能相關需求持續增長的信心。同時，投資者開始更著重企業能否將AI投入轉化為實際盈利，而非單純受惠於人工智能概念。儘管通脹及聯儲局貨幣政策預期仍為市場帶來一定波動，但穩健的經濟數據及相對穩定的政策前景為股市提供支持。雖然市場對年內減息的預期有所降溫，但聯儲局維持數據依賴的政策立場，有助支撐股票估值，尤其利好資訊科技等成長板塊。
managerCommentary.en: The S&P 500 returned 14.4% in second quarter 2026. As easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, declining oil prices, and resilient corporate earnings supported a sharp rebound in US Equities. Investor sentiment improved throughout the quarter as concerns over the Iran conflict subsided following the US-Iran ceasefire, while confidence in the economic outlook remained constructive. Market leadership was driven by growth-oriented sectors, particularly technology, as investors became increasingly comfortable with the balance between economic growth and inflation risks. The AI investment cycle remained the dominant market theme, with strong capital spending on semiconductors, AI infrastructure, data centres, and cloud services underpinning equity performance. Record earnings from leading semiconductor companies reinforced confidence in the sustainability of AI-related demand, while investors increasingly differentiated between companies with tangible AI-driven earnings and those with only thematic exposure. Although inflation and Federal Reserve policy expectations continued to create periods of volatility, markets were supported by resilient economic data and a relatively stable policy outlook. While expectations for rate cuts moderated during the quarter, confidence that monetary policy would remain data-dependent helped sustain equity valuations, particularly across growth and technology sectors.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理評論
managerCommentary.zh: 歐洲股市於第二季以美元計上升7.6%。在3月底因市場憂慮中東衝突引發持久能源衝擊而出現大幅調整後，隨著地緣政治緊張局勢緩和及能源價格回落，市場逐步企穩回升。布蘭特原油大致回復至衝突前水平，紓緩了宏觀經濟面臨的一項主要不確定因素。歐元區方面，由於通脹持續高於目標水平，歐洲央行於6月將存款利率上調25個基點至2.25%，而5月整體消費物價指數按年升幅為3.2%。歐洲央行同時上調今明兩年的通脹預測，並下調經濟增長展望。行業表現方面，在強勁企業盈利及市場對人工智能前景樂觀情緒的支持下，資訊科技及金融板塊表現領先。相反，能源及電訊板塊於季內表現落後，其中能源板塊受油價下跌拖累最為明顯，因地緣政治風險溢價隨著局勢緩和而逐步消退。
managerCommentary.en: European equities gained 7.6% QoQ in USD terms during the second quarter. Following the sharp correction at the end of March, driven by fears of a prolonged energy shock stemming from Middle East hostilities, markets progressively regained footing as geopolitical tensions eased and energy prices retreated. Brent crude broadly reverted to pre-conflict levels and relieving a key source of macro uncertainty. In the eurozone, the ECB raised its deposit rate by 25 basis points in June to 2.25%, with headline CPI at 3.2% YoY in May. The ECB also raised its outlook for inflation for this year and next and cut its growth projections. Information Technology and Financials outperformed amid some strong corporate earnings and optimism over the outlook for AI. Energy and Telecommunications underperformed during the quarter as with the energy sector bearing the brunt of the oil price decline as the geopolitical risk premium unwound.

managerCommentary.en: The S&P 500 returned 14.4% in second quarter 2026, its strongest quarterly gain since 2020, as easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, declining oil prices, and resilient corporate earnings supported a sharp rebound in US Equities. Investor sentiment improved throughout the quarter as concerns over the Iran conflict subsided following the US-Iran ceasefire, while confidence in the economic outlook remained constructive. Market leadership was driven by growth-oriented sectors, particularly technology, as investors became increasingly comfortable with the balance between economic growth and inflation risks. The AI investment cycle remained the dominant market theme, with strong capital spending on semiconductors, AI infrastructure, data centres, and cloud services underpinning equity performance. Record earnings from leading semiconductor companies reinforced confidence in the sustainability of AI-related demand, while investors increasingly differentiated between companies with tangible AI-driven earnings and those with only thematic exposure. Although inflation and Federal Reserve policy expectations continued to create periods of volatility, markets were supported by resilient economic data and a relatively stable policy outlook. While expectations for rate cuts moderated during the quarter, confidence that monetary policy would remain data-dependent helped sustain equity valuations, particularly across growth and technology sectors. MSCI Hong Kong Index and MSCI China Index returned -8.8% and -8.6% respectively in USD total return terms for Q2 2026. Both indices significantly lagged the MSCI Asia Pacific Index over the same period. Compared with the semiconductor and AI-related rallies in Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan, Hong Kong and China were among the very few markets globally to post negative USD returns for the quarter as structural concerns around China's macroeconomics outlook, regulatory headwinds for internet platforms, and commodity sector weakness drove broad-based declines.

managerCommentary.heading: 基金經理評論
managerCommentary.zh: 今年年初股市整體表現強勁，但自美伊地緣政治衝突爆發以來走勢逆轉。以富時MPF全球指數衡量的全球股市本季下跌2.5%。年初我們積極配置風險資產，但自3月起大幅縮減規模以規避下行風險。自4月初以來，我們已重新配置資金。由於能源價格上漲的影響，投資者對利率/通膨前景的不確定性加劇，導致市場波動加劇，紛紛降低風險敞口，而房地產投資信託基金（REITs）則提供了穩定性和收益。該基金維持了分紅份額類別的收益分配，目前收益率約為3%
managerCommentary.en: Equities in general had a strong start to the year but reversed since the US-Iran geopolitical outbreak. Global equities, measured by FTSE MPF All World, fell -2.5% for the quarter. We have been constructive in risk assets to start the year, but scaled back meaningfully since March to protect downside. Capital has been deployed back since early April. During a volatile quarter where investors de-risked with less visibility on interest rate / inflation outlook due to impact of higher energy prices, REITS have offered stability and income.The fund maintained its income distribution for the distribution share class with a running yield of ~3%.
